abstract: The invention discloses a passive biped robot with bionic hip joints and ankle joints, and relates to the technical field of bionic robots, the passive biped robot comprises a hip assembly, a leg assembly and an ankle assembly; and the leg assembly is arranged between the hip assembly and the ankle assembly. The bionic hip joint realizes the movement of the biped robot hip joint on three planes, is more similar to the hip joint movement range of human gaits, and is beneficial to natural walking. Under the condition that no external drive is added to the biped robot, alternate swing of the two legs is achieved through elastic starting of the foot springs. The bionic ankle achieves elastic starting in the walking process, and meanwhile the adaptability of the toes to walking on the ground is improved.
source_title: Passive biped robot with bionic hip joints and ankle joints

abstract: The invention relates to a motor-driven biped lower limb walking structure and a working method thereof. The walking structure comprises a hip skeleton, a thigh skeleton, a shank skeleton and a foot plate. The upper end of the thigh skeleton is movably connected with the hip skeleton through hip joints; the lower end of the thigh skeleton is movably connected with the shank skeleton through knee joints; and the lower end of the shank skeleton is movably connected with the foot plate through ankle joints. A first motor assembly is installed on the thigh skeleton, the output end of the first motor assembly is fixedly connected with a crank, the crank is hinged to the upper end of a connecting rod, and the lower end of the connecting rod is hinged to the upper portion of the shank skeleton. The motor drives the knee joints to rotate through a four-connecting-rod mechanism and thus stable walking of the lower limbs of the biped robot is realized, so that a problem that the inertia of legsis large because the motor is directly installed at the knee joint is solved; timely response of shanks and feet is achieved, the response speed of foot ends can be remarkably increased, and installation and debugging are convenient.
source_title: Motor-driven biped lower limb walking structure and working method thereof

abstract: The invention, which relates to the technical field of indoor social distance monitoring, discloses a social distance monitoring robot based on a YOLO algorithm, comprising an array type pressure sensing film assembly, a wireless transmission module, a service robot and a social distance reminding module. The array type pressure sensing thin film assembly is laid below a floor of a monitoring area needing the social distance and is in wireless communication connection with a main control circuit board of the service robot through the wireless transmission module, and the service robot judges the social distance according to data monitored by the array type pressure sensing thin film assembly. According to the invention, the array type pressure sensing film assembly is adopted to monitor the contour image and position of a human biped pressure signal from the ground, and then matching of a human biped standing state image database is carried out through a YOLOV5 algorithm, so that the miscellaneous influence caused by directly adopting a video to monitor a social distance is avoided; the efficiency and accuracy of social distance monitoring are greatly improved.
source_title: Social distance monitoring robot based on YOLO algorithm

abstract: The invention discloses a variable-stiffness driver based on a magnetorheological elastomer. The variable-stiffness driver comprises an input connecting rod frame, a lever arm, an output connecting rod and a variable-stiffness mechanism, the input connecting rod frame forms a driver outer frame, provides space and positions for installation of other parts, and is provided with a driving motor. One end of the lever arm is fixedly connected with the driving motor and serves as a bridge for changing the balance position and arranging the variable stiffness mechanism; one end of the output connecting rod is mounted on the input connecting rod frame in a position coaxial with the driving motor through a rotating pair; the variable stiffness mechanism is composed of a spring-like mechanism and a push rod motor, the stiffness of the magnetorheological elastomer is influenced by changing an external magnetic field, and the change of the joint stiffness is realized by pre-tightening the spring-like mechanism through the push rod motor. Compared with a traditional variable-rigidity driver achieved through a pre-tightening spring, the variable-rigidity driver is larger in rigidity change range, more in change mode and higher in change speed, and application of the variable-rigidity driver in scenes such as biped robots is facilitated.
source_title: Variable stiffness driver based on magnetorheological elastomer

abstract: The invention provides a symmetrical rimless wheel model motion behavior adjusting method based on a motion stopping attraction domain. The method comprises the steps: constructing and describing theinitial state of a symmetrical rimless wheel model based on the initial kinetic energy and slope inclination angle of the symmetrical rimless wheel model, creating a state coordinate system, and enabling an interval formed by the state coordinate system to be an attraction domain region; classifying the final stable state attraction domain according to the model parameters, and constructing and obtaining a corresponding attraction domain area in the state coordinate system; calculating boundaries among a plurality of different attraction domain areas; according to the initial state and the attraction domain area, jointly calculating a final stable state of the symmetrical sideless wheel model; and enabling the final stable state to meet the expectation by adjusting model parameters. According to the method, a complete adjustment method capable of realizing expected motion characteristics is constructed based on calculation and analysis of a stop motion attraction domain of the symmetrical rimless wheel model, and a practical scheme is provided for guiding biped walking simulation research of a real robot by using the rimless wheel model.
source_title: Symmetrical rimless wheel model motion behavior adjusting method based on motion stopping attraction domain

abstract: A two-legged walking robot constructed such that a lower thigh link (9) and a foot sole section (11) of a leg section (2) are connected to each other by a linear actuator (124) at a position away from an ankle joint section (10) and that the foot sole section (11) rocks about the ankle joint section (10) relative to the lower thigh link (9) by extension and retraction of the linear actuator(124), wherein predetermined moment required for the robot to walk on stairs can be applied to the foot sole section (11) without an increase in the size of the linear actuator (124). The linear actuator (124) is placedso that its extension and retraction force acts on a line (L2) tilted backward relative to a connection line (L1) interconnecting a knee joint section (8) and the ankle joint section (10). Preferably, a connection section (Y3a) at which the linear actuator (124) is connected to the lower thigh link (9) is positioned behind the connection line (L1) and a connection section (Y3b) at which the linear actuator (124) is connected to the foot sole section (11) is positioned in front of the connection line (L1).
source_title: TWO-LEGGED WALKING ROBOT

abstract: The invention discloses a reconfigurable foot type robot with a double-foot/four-wheel/four-foot motion mode. The robot comprises a trunk part, a hip deflection direction component, a hip rolling direction component, a hip leg connecting component, a thigh component, a shank component, a driving wheel connecting piece, a driving wheel, a sole component, a sole adjusting component and a driven wheel, by changing the joint movement amount and a driving mode of the driving joint, switching of the foot type robot among three movement modes of two feet, four wheels and four feet is achieved, and the efficient work of the robot in different environments is facilitated. The robot is advantaged in that the reconfigurable characteristic advantage of the foot-type robot is brought into full play, the environmental adaptability of the robot is improved, motion characteristics of the robot are enriched, and the application scene of the robot is expanded.
source_title: Reconfigurable foot type robot with double-foot/four-wheel/four-foot motion mode

abstract: The invention discloses a bionic obstacle-crossing double-foot jumping mechanical device. The bionic obstacle-crossing double-foot jumping mechanical device comprises a lower limb jumping mechanism, an upper limb grabbing mechanism, a main body structure, an inertia pendulum mechanism and a transmission mechanism. Wherein the upper limb grabbing mechanism and the lower limb jumping mechanism are jointly connected to the robot main body structure. The lower limb jumping mechanism is of a symmetrical structure and is connected with the transmission mechanism through a crank connecting rod, and stretching and compressing movement of the leg mechanism can be completed. The upper limb grabbing mechanism is similar to the lower limb jumping mechanism, and the upper limb grabbing mechanism plays an auxiliary role when the lower limbs jump, so that the lower limbs of the robot can complete two times of force storage jumping. The transmission mechanism is embedded in the main body structure, and power is transmitted to execution components of the biped robot through gears and transmission shafts. The inertia pendulum mechanism plays a role in balancing the posture of the jumping robot in the air. According to the double-foot jumping robot, the climbing action of a wall with a certain height can be completed through two times of continuous jumping.
source_title: Bionic obstacle-crossing double-foot jumping mechanical device

abstract:
PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a robotic device and an expression method of the robotic device which makes expression according to complicated and various emotions or states of instinct and motion, such as important information realizing smooth communication with a human by highly efficiently using limited resources.

SOLUTION: This robotic device expresses a plurality of states such as emotional states and sense perception states by a light emitting device mounted on a position equivalent to the eyes in the head part of a bipedal human type robotic device. The light emitting device is provided with hues, saturations, and light emission patterns as expression units showing mutually independent orthogonal expressions. The plurality of orthogonal states, namely for example, the emotional states and the sense perception states are simultaneously expressed using a plurality of orthogonal expressions of the light emitting device, which are linked by a link means linking the plurality of mutually orthogonal states based on own internal states and external stimuli with, at least, a single expression unit.

COPYRIGHT: (C)2004,JPO&NCIPI
source_title: ROBOTIC DEVICE AND EXPRESSION METHOD OF ROBOTIC DEVICE

abstract: The invention discloses a double-foot wall-climbing robot driven by inflatable air bags. The double-foot wall-climbing robot comprises two sets of suction cup lifting foot assemblies and a flexible steering assembly. The two sets of suction cup lifting foot assemblies are connected through the flexible steering assembly, the suction cup lifting foot assemblies and the flexible steering assembly are matched to achieve alternate walking of the two sets of suction cup lifting foot assemblies, and the suction cup lifting foot assemblies are used for crossing obstacles. The air bag assembly is ingeniously used as power for walking and obstacle crossing of the robot, the problems of high energy consumption and complex structure of a transmission mode of a double-foot wall-climbing robot are solved in an inflatable air bag transmission mode, and the use of a power source is reduced; the air bag assembly can be combined with the spring assembly, so that the leg lifting height of the biped wall-climbing robot can be adjusted, and the service life of the biped robot can be prolonged; meanwhile, the air bag assembly can be matched with the flexible steering assembly, the step size and the walking direction of the robot walking on the wall face can be controlled, and the robot is high in flexibility and not prone to damage.
source_title: Inflatable airbag-driven double-foot wall-climbing robot

abstract: The invention discloses a biped robot bionic foot with terrain adaptive capacity and rigidity adjustability, which comprises a front sole, a rear sole, a locust-imitating sole structure, an arch piece, a six-dimensional force sensor and an ankle joint support, and is characterized in that the arch piece is connected with the sole and is connected with the ankle joint support through the six-dimensional force sensor; the simulated locust sole structure adopts a composite structure of an upper rigid framework, a lower rigid framework and a simulated locust foot pad, the simulated locust sole structure is actively attached to the irregular ground through a liquid bag and a flexible bottom face, multi-point contact is achieved, friction force and ground gripping performance are improved, liquid bag partitions are arranged in the simulated locust foot pad, human sole pressure distribution is simulated, the liquid bag can adjust the liquid volume, and dynamic rigidity adjustment is achieved. The arch piece is of an arch-shaped elastic structure, the arch piece is matched with the liquid bag, the rigidity of the arch is adjusted in a linkage mode so as to adapt to the impact load or the gait stage, the buffering capacity is enhanced, the outer ring liquid bag in the liquid bag is used for buffering initial impact, the center liquid bag bears main supporting force, the elastic deformation of the arch is matched, the impact peak value is reduced, and the gait stability is improved.
source_title: Biped robot bionic foot with terrain adaptive capacity and rigidity adjustment

abstract: The invention discloses a control method of a bionic biped robot and the bionic biped robot. Legs of the bionic biped robot comprise a hip mechanism, a knee mechanism, an ankle mechanism and a toe mechanism which are sequentially connected through connecting rods, each of the hip mechanism, the knee mechanism and the ankle mechanism comprises a plurality of joints, the toe mechanism comprises a toe joint and a sole connected with the toe joint, and the control method comprises: obtaining a moving instruction of the bionic biped robot, determining an initial state and an end point state of a leg of the bionic biped robot; according to the terminal point state of the leg, determining the terminal point pose of the toe joint; according to the initial state of the leg and the end point pose of the toe joint, determining the turning angle of each joint in the hip mechanism, the knee mechanism and the ankle mechanism; according to the rotation angle of each joint and the initial state of the leg, determining the speed, acceleration and force of each joint, and controlling each joint to rotate, so that the bionic biped robot moves according to the movement instruction.
source_title: Control method of bionic biped robot and bionic biped robot

abstract: The invention provides a leg mechanism and a biped robot, and relates to the technical field of robots. The leg mechanism comprises a shank skeleton, a foot movably connected to one end of the shank skeleton, a thigh skeleton movably connected to the other end of the shank skeleton, a hip assembly, a knee assembly, a leg rotating assembly and a leg swinging assembly. The swing leg assembly comprises a first joint and a swing leg connecting piece; the rotating leg assembly comprises a second joint and a rotating leg connecting piece; the hip component comprises a third joint and a hip connecting piece; the knee component comprises a fourth joint and a knee connecting piece; the leg swinging connecting piece is fixedly connected with the second joint, the leg rotating connecting piece is fixedly connected with the third joint, the hip connecting piece is relatively fixed to the fourth joint and the thigh skeleton, the knee connecting piece is in transmission connection with the shank skeleton, and the rotating axis of the hip connecting piece and the rotating axis of the knee connecting piece are collinear. The leg mechanism can reduce the weight of the tail end, so that the inertia of the leg is reduced, and the power consumption is reduced.
source_title: Leg mechanism and biped robot

abstract: The invention discloses a biped robot dynamic motion generation and control method which comprises the following steps: in a single-foot supporting period, establishing a whole-body dynamics feedbacklinearization controller to control the lengths of supporting legs and the pitching posture of an upper body so as to keep the dynamic motion characteristics of a biped robot; decoupling the kinetic coupling of the swinging leg and the whole body based on a whole body kinetic model, controlling the position of future observation planning by establishing a swinging leg prediction control model, giving a series of target points at the tail end of the future leg through the adjustment of the foothold, planning the tail end track of the swinging leg according to the environmental information, andadjusting the foothold of the movable leg in real time; taking the whole body dynamic moment control quantity of the supporting legs and the control moment of the swinging legs as the motion control input of the biped robot; according to the method, the dynamics of the biped robot is introduced into real-time planning and online control, a high-dimensional nonlinear system is decoupled, and the swinging legs are independently controlled to achieve dynamic stable movement.
source_title: Dynamic motion generation and control method for biped robot

abstract: The invention discloses a foot state detection device of a biped robot and a slope walking method. The foot state detection device comprises a pressure sensor module, an AD conversion module, an inertia measurement module, a communication module, a microcontroller module and a power module. On a basis of realizing an original foot pressure detection function, the foot state detection device of thebiped robot can detect a foot angle state, slope information detection of the ground is realized, and feedback is provided for the biped robot walking on a slope. The slope walking method is simple to realize, and the walking stability and adaptive capacity to the environment of the biped robot can be improved.
source_title: Foot state detection device of biped robot and slope walking method based on foot state detection device

abstract: A walking pattern generation system generates a walking pattern of a biped walking robot. The walking pattern generation system includes a pole-zero controller for converting a target pattern data input to the system into a reference pattern data through a first transfer function, and a walking pattern generation unit for converting the reference pattern data into a walking pattern data through a second transfer function and outputting the converted walking pattern data, wherein the second transfer function has an unstable zero, and wherein the first transfer function includes a transfer function approximated to an inverse of the unstable zero of the second transfer function.
source_title: Walking pattern generation system for biped walking robot

abstract: The invention discloses a damping leg of a biped robot. The damping leg comprises an upper body support, hip joint composite driving mechanisms, thighs, knee joint motors, shanks, ankle joint spherical hinges, three layers of composite soles and adjustable spring-damping shock absorbers. The adjustable spring-damping shock absorber and the knee joint motor are connected between the thigh and the shank in parallel. The three-layer composite sole is divided into a bearing layer, a buffer layer and a contact layer below the ankle joint spherical hinge. The structural design that the adjustable spring-damping shock absorber is connected with the knee joint motor in parallel gets rid of the limitation of the installation range of a traditional built-in shock absorber, and efficient cooperation of shock absorption and driving is achieved. When the foot sole falls to the ground, the load is absorbed by the foot sole buffer layer and the adjustable spring-damping shock absorbers together, so that a multi-damping effect is formed.
source_title: Damping leg of biped robot

abstract: The invention discloses a biped bionic mechanical chicken which comprises a part above a body, the body and a part below the body. Multi-space and multi-angle object clamping and image information acquisition of the bionic mechanical chicken are realized on the part above the body through multi-axis movement of a mechanical arm, and the functions of object taking and unmanned environment monitoring are realized; the body part is provided with a distance measuring module, a voice broadcasting module, a data transmission module and the like and an intelligent household appliance control unit, so that diversified functions are realized, and multi-aspect application requirements of intelligent home and the like are met; the momentum wheel is arranged on the part below the body, the posture balance of the whole machine in the advancing process can be adjusted only by changing the rotating direction and speed of the momentum wheel, and the balance condition of the biped system is simplified; the mechanical claws are arranged on the portion below the body and can be freely opened and grabbed, the obstacle avoiding and crossing capacity of the whole machine is greatly improved in combination with contraction of the mechanical legs, the adaptability to different application scenes is enhanced, and therefore the robot has wide application prospects.
source_title: Biped bionic mechanical chicken

abstract: Disclosed are robotic systems, methods, bipedal robot devices, and computer-readable mediums. For example, a robotic system may include a robotic body having an axis; a sensor connected to the robotic body, where the sensor is configured to receive information within a scanning area; two or more robotic legs connected to the robotic body, where the two or more robotic legs are configured to operate in a starting position and a use position, where in the starting position the robotic system is substantially stationary; and one or more protrusions connected to the robotic body, where the one or more protrusions extend from the robotic body at a non-perpendicular angle from the axis of the robotic body and are located outside of the scanning area of the sensor, and where in the starting position the one or more protrusions are configured to support the robotic system.
source_title: Robotic systems having protrusions for use in starting positions and in use positions

abstract: A biped robot indoor and outdoor road surface dynamic running gait implementation method, wherein a state machine for an entire running cycle is arranged, and balance control and motion trajectory planning of a robot is performed in each state. When the robot changes from an in-the-air phase to an on-the-ground phase, posture balancing and ground cushioning are controlled by means of a SLIP model, and after the robot is stably on the ground, the centre of mass of the robot is controlled to a set height by means of a LIP model. In addition, the in-the-air phase of the robot running is generated via support leg and swing leg trajectory planning and state switching, to implement the running motion of the robot, increase the motion speed of the robot, and improve the dynamic balancing performance of the robot running. The method has a certain versatility with respect to common biped robots, and also has good adaptability to uneven outdoor terrain.
source_title: BIPED ROBOT UNEVEN ROAD SURFACE DYNAMIC RUNNING GAIT IMPLEMENTATION METHOD

abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of robots, in particular to a biped robot capable of crossing feet. The biped robot comprises a top board, a control board, copper columns, U-shaped connecting pieces, steering gears and foot boards. The copper columns comprise the first copper columns and the second copper columns. The U-shaped connecting pieces comprise the first U-shaped connecting pieces, the second U-shaped connecting pieces, the third U-shaped connecting pieces, the fourth U-shaped connecting pieces and the fifth U-shaped connecting pieces. The steering gears comprise the first steering gear, the second steering gear and the third steering gear. The top board is fixedly connected with the control board through the multiple first copper columns, and the top board and the control board keep parallel to each other. Bases of the two first U-shaped connecting pieces are correspondingly connected with the lower surface of the control board (3) through fixing connection pieces respectively. The biped robot capable of crossing the feet has the advantages that the walking stability of the biped robot capable of crossing the feet is improved, and the length of a single step of the biped robot capable of crossing the feet during walking is increased.
source_title: Biped robot capable of crossing feet

abstract: The invention discloses a biped robot capable of conducting wheeled motion and a working method thereof. The biped robot comprises a top mounting plate, the left side and the right side of the bottomof the top mounting plate are connected with a first foot sole plate and a second foot sole plate for walking through three steering engines correspondingly, and the left-front side and the right-front side of the top mounting plate are connected with a first wheel and a second wheel through a first steering engine and an eighth steering engine correspondingly. The biped robot has the characteristics of simple structure and large wheel diameter size, can quickly roll on the flat terrain, and has high terrain adaptability; and the robot can also be switched into a foot-type robot in a biped form, can realize a walking mode similar to lower limbs of a human body, can adapt to the rugged and complex terrain environment, is simple and reasonable in overall structure and easy to deform, and canbe widely applied to occasions of production and life.
source_title: Biped robot capable of conducting wheeled motion and working method thereof

abstract: The invention discloses a brain-like decision and motion control system. The system comprises an active decision module, an automatic decision module, an evaluation module, a memory module, a sensingmodule, a composite control module, an input channel module, an output channel module and a controlled object module, three working modes supported by the system comprise an active supervision mode, an automatic mode and a feedback driving mode. The robot can autonomously decide and select targets and operations and finely control actions in the process of interacting with the environment; the robot can learn new operation through trial and error, simulation and teaching; complex and changeable tasks and environments can be flexibly adapted; the system is particularly suitable for being applied to the scenes of motion planning and control of a multi-degree-of-freedom robot, cooperative operation of a dexterous hand and a camera, walking and balancing of a biped or multi-legged robot, antagonistic control of multiple execution elements and the like, and therefore some problems existing in an existing robot motion control scheme are effectively solved.
source_title: Brain-like decision and motion control system

abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of robots, and particularly relates to a robot control method and device, a computer readable storage medium and a robot. The method comprises the steps that the step length of the robot in the advancing process is obtained; the mass center swing angle amplitude and the double-arm swing angle amplitude of the robot are determined according to the step length; the position vector difference between the mass center of the robot and the two feet is obtained; a swing angle coefficient of the robot is calculated according to the position vector difference and the step length; according to the swing angle coefficient, the mass center swing angle amplitude and the double-arm swing angle amplitude, the mass center swing angle and the double-arm swing angle of the robot are determined; and the robot is controlled to move according to the mass center swing angle and the double-arm swing angle. According to the method, the corresponding swing angles are planned for the mass center and the two arms of the robot, the deflection torque generated in the walking process can be effectively counteracted, and the stability of the robot is greatly improved.
source_title: Robot control method and device, computer readable storage medium and robot

abstract: The invention, which relates to the field of factory intelligent management, discloses an intelligent bionic biped inspection robot comprising a background control module, a target determination module, a route determination module and a walking navigation module. The target determination module is used for receiving an inspection instruction issued by the control center, analyzing the inspection instruction to obtain a to-be-inspected area, and determining walking routes of the inspection robot advancing from the current position to the to-be-inspected area and inspection areas where the walking routes need to pass according to the to-be-inspected area obtained through analysis; the route determination module is used for obtaining the determined walking routes and sequentially judging the inspection states of the inspection areas needing to pass through in the walking routes. According to the invention, ordered navigation when the inspection robot walks to the to-be-inspected area can be realized, and the inspection robot does not interfere with the inspection robots working in other inspection areas in the walking process.
source_title: Intelligent bionic double-foot inspection robot

abstract: A high-load construction robot is characterized in that a control system of the robot is provided with a dynamic stability control module, wherein the dynamic stability control module is internally provided with a stability constraint condition, and the stability constraint condition is the relationship between the ZMP position and the joint angle, the angular velocity, the angular acceleration and the external load; (Fex, Fey, Fez) represents a force of a load acting on the robot in the x direction, a force of a load acting on the robot in the y direction, and a force of a load acting on therobot in the z direction; (Mex, Mey, Mez) represents a moment of a load acting on the robot in the x-direction, a moment of a load acting on the robot in the y-direction, and a moment of a load actingon the robot in the z-direction; and (xe, ye, ze) represents the position where the load acts on the robot. According to the high-load construction robot, the ZMP stability criterion widely applied to gait planning and stability control of a biped robot is applied to dynamic stability control of the construction robot, the advantage that the ZMP criterion can realize real-time dynamic stability judgment of the robot is exerted, and a stability control method of a large construction robot under high load can realize real-time observation feedback on the stable state of the dynamically operatedrobot, so as to control the robot to operate in a limited stability margin.
source_title: High-load construction robot

abstract: The invention discloses a variable topology spoke walking biped robot. The variable topology spoke walking biped robot includes a left wheel foot assembly, a right wheel foot assembly, a left shank assembly, a right shank assembly, a left thigh assembly, a right thigh assembly and hip joint assemblies. The left wheel foot assembly and the right wheel foot assembly are connected with the lower endsof the left shank assembly and the right shank assembly correspondingly. The left shank assembly and the right shank assembly are connected with the lower parts of the left thigh assembly and the right thigh assembly. The upper ends of the left thigh assembly and the right thigh assembly are connected with the hip joint assemblies. Rotatable main bodies are correspondingly arranged in the left wheel foot assembly and the right wheel foot assembly. Three spokes which are distributed at 60 degree at intervals are arranged in each main body in a penetrating mode. Each spoke can reciprocate in the length direction of the corresponding spoke. Each main body is used for extending and contracting the corresponding spoke according to needs of road conditions of a landing place before landing. According to the variable topology spoke walking biped robot, because every three spokes which are distributed at 60 degree at intervals and can reciprocate in the length direction of the spokes are used, the unique mobility is formed by combining with leg parts of the biped robot, the adaptability to complicated terrains such as potholes, mountain, flat ground and obstacle crossing of the biped robot is improved, the energy consumption is low, and the walking efficiency is high.
source_title: Variable topology spoke walking biped robot

abstract:
PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a high-speed and stable robot device which surely grounds legs including wheels even on an irregular ground surface and realizes stable walking.

SOLUTION: A mobile robot includes a controller 110, a barrel 100 having a gradient angle sensor for detecting a gradient angle and angular speed, and a plurality of legs 11 having a femur 12 and a lower limb 13 in which the femur can rotate around an X axis in the forward direction of the barrel and a Y axis in a lateral direction of the barrel. It includes the wheel 14 provided under the lower limb 13 and rotatable around the Y axis and a movable support 15 rotatable around the Y axis under the lower limb 13 and capable of grounding on a road surface. Coaxial two-wheel inverted pendulum control operation for moving in an inverted posture kept by the wheels 14 without grounding the movable support 15 according to the unevenness of the road surface and two-legged locomotion control operation for walking by controlling the grounding of the wheels 14 and the movable support 15 on the road surface are changed over.

COPYRIGHT: (C)2008,JPO&INPIT
source_title: MOBILE ROBOT

abstract: A direct-acting link device and a two-legged walking robot with the device are provided. The direct-acting link device is held and locked by a holding brake so as not to telescope during the stop of an actuator. As a result, a load on the actuator is reduced, and electric power consumption is reduced. A direct-acting link device (1) has an actuator (28) and is telescopable in the length direction by the drive of the actuator (28), and the device comprises a holding brake (30) for holding and locking a movable section (41) of the actuator (28). A two-legged walking robot comprises the direct-acting link device (1) having the holding brake (30) for holding and locking the movable section (41) of the actuator (28).
source_title: Direct-acting link device and two-legged walking robot therewith

abstract: The invention discloses a ducted push-aiding device and method making a biped robot step over obstacles. A controller calculates out theoretical thrust needing to be provided by a ducted fan to ensure that the robot steps over obstacles in a balance mode according to the step-over trajectory of the step-over sole of the robot, and sends the theoretical thrust to a processor; the processor identifies the instruction, generates a corresponding PWM signal and sends the PWM signal to an electronic speed regulator of the ducted fan, and the electronic speed regulator controls the ducted fan according to the PWM signal and generates corresponding thrust. Through auxiliary thrust of ducted fan and cooperation with the motion characteristics of the robot itself, the overturning moment of the robot when the robot steps over obstacles is balanced, the problem that the obstacle crossing ability of the robot is scarce can be well solved, the obstacle crossing ability of the robot is improved, and the purpose of expanding the working environment of the robot is achieved.
source_title: Ducted push-aiding device and method making biped robot step over obstacles

abstract: PURPOSE: A birdlike robot is provided to reduce a load of each actuator by delivering a driving force of the actuator to a second joint unit and a third joint unit through a tendon structure. CONSTITUTION: A birdlike robot includes a leg module (10). The leg module is installed in a body unit and performs a biped walking or swimming. The leg module includes a first leg (20), a first joint unit (30), a second leg (40), a second joint unit (50), a foot unit (60), and a third joint unit (70). The first leg dually rotates relative to the body unit. The first joint unit is arranged between the first leg and the body unit and supplies the dual rotation to the first leg. The second leg is connected to the first leg and rotates forwards and backwards. The second joint unit is arranged between the first leg and the second leg and supplies a rotational movement to the second leg. The foot unit is connected to the second joint unit and supports the ground or supplies a driving force in the swimming. The third joint unit is arranged between the foot unit and the second joint unit to be rotated to left and right sides or forward and backward directions.
source_title: BIRDLIKE ROBOT

abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of robots, and discloses a joint module adopting an outer rotor motor, a biped robot, a point-foot robot, a quadruped robot, a four-wheel-foot robot, a mechanical arm and a robot. Wherein the joint module mainly comprises a shell, a motor, a planetary reducer, a fixing disc, a first bearing and a rotor output shaft, the inner ring and the outer ring of the first bearing abut against the connecting shaft end and the bearing fixing part correspondingly, so that the bearing fixing part is close to the connecting shaft end, and at least part of the bearing fixing part is overlapped with the projection, in the radial direction, of an annular avoiding cavity; according to the joint module, the bearing fixing part can partially extend into the annular avoiding cavity, and the axial space of the annular avoiding cavity is utilized to accommodate part of the bearing fixing part, so that the structure is more compact in the axial direction, and the axial size of the joint module can be reduced.
source_title: Joint module, biped robot, point-foot robot, quadruped robot, four-wheel-foot robot, mechanical arm and robot

abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of servo control, and discloses a pelvic structure of a biped robot. The pelvic structure comprises a large pelvic plate, two driving mechanisms, a swinging plate member and two turntables. The large pelvic plate is stepped in shape and comprises a first support plate, a second support plate and a connecting plate. Two ends of the connecting plate are vertically connected with the first support plate and the second support plate respectively. Two turntables are movably connected to the second support plate respectively; Two driving mechanisms are respectively arranged on the first support plate and the second support plate, and are respectively connected with the two turntables; The driving mechanism is used for converting the linear movement into the rotation of the turntable, thereby driving the legs of the biped robot to rotate; The swing plate is movably connected to the second support plate, which moves in the same height space with thetwo driving mechanisms and drives the biped robot to swing. The invention reduces the height from the sole of the foot to the pelvis, reduces the volume, and improves the space utilization rate.
source_title: A pelvic structure of a biped robot

abstract: The invention provides a method for planning and controlling gaits when a biped robot suffers from external thrust disturbance in the advancing direction. When the robot is provided with under-actuated ankles or the ankles are in a force control manner, external disturbance borne by the robot can be shown through the state change of the ankle joint freedom degree (or other variables relevant to the ankle joint freedom degree). Based on the thought, according to the method for planning and controlling the gaits, the force control manner is adopted for the ankle joints of the robot, then the included angles between connecting lines between the supporting leg ankles and supporting leg hip joints and the vertical direction are selected to serve as the state variables of the robot to representthe state of the robot, and the state of the robot is estimated and calculated in real time based on a simplified inverted pendulum model. Based on the method, external thrust information borne by therobot does not need to be measured, and real-time feedback and control can be achieved.
source_title: Method for planning and controlling gaits when biped robot suffers from external thrust disturbance in advancing direction

abstract: A robot remote manipulation system is provided, including a bipedal walking robot (20) and a remote manipulation device (10) for remotely manipulating the bipedal walking robot (20). The robot (20) is connected to the remote manipulation device (10) via a communication network (100) and controlled by controlling data from the remote manipulation device (10). In the system, the remote manipulation device (10) comprises a pair of bilateral mechanical rotating elements (11,50) providing a quantity of motion for each bilateral leg of the bipedal walking robot (20); and a controlling data transmitter (18) for transmitting controlling data corresponding to the quantities of motion to the bipedal walking robot (20). The bipedal walking robot (20) comprises a controlling data receiver (23) for receiving the controlling data transmitted from the remote manipulation device (10); and a leg motion controller for processing the received controlling data and causing the bilateral legs to move forward or backward. <IMAGE>
source_title: Walking robot remote-control system, apparatus and method

abstract: A bipedal walking robot uses a quasi-passive control scheme and a simplified mechanical design. The walking robot has a pair of legs connected to a body through a passive hip joint, which is offset from a center of gravity of the walking robot. A nonconcentric, curved foot is attached at to each leg by a prismatic joint. Extension and retraction of the prismatic joint initiates the walking sequence of the robot, with each foot retracted during the swing phase and extended during the stance phase. Directional changes are controlled by changing a phase offset in the actuation of each foot.
source_title: Three-dimensional passive walking robot

abstract: The invention discloses an ankle joint bionic control method and control module for upright balance of a biped robot, and relates to the field of biped robot balance control. According to the ankle joint angle theta foot of the biped robot at a certain moment and the movement speed vc and acceleration ac information of the mass center of the biped robot, bionics modeling is carried out, and the ankle joint angle theta foot of the biped robot at a certain moment is obtained. The expected ankle joint acting moment tau q in the current state is obtained through calculation, and then an ankle joint driver acts to generate the expected ankle joint acting moment, so that the force exerting action of the biped robot is adjusted, and the biped robot is kept upright and balanced. On the basis of bionics, the method is established in combination with parameters of the biped robot and does not depend on the external environment where the biped robot is located, and therefore the self-adaptability and robustness of the method are guaranteed; meanwhile, instantaneous adjustment is carried out according to the motion parameters of the biped robot and the state parameters of the biped robot, feedback is more timely and accurate, and the balance adjusting and controlling effect is better.
source_title: Ankle joint bionic control method and control module for upright balance of biped robot

abstract: An implementation may involve causing a foot of a robot to orient in a first position, where the foot comprises a sole configured to contact a surface, where the sole comprises a first edge and a second edge, and where in the first position: (i) the first edge contacts the surface, and (ii) a zero moment point (ZMP) is located on the first edge; receiving, from a force sensor, (i) first force data indicative of a first force and (ii) first moment data indicative of a first moment; determining a calibration of the force sensor based at least in part on the first force data, the first moment data, and a distance between the ZMP and a measurement location on the robot; and while the robot is engaged in bipedal movement, controlling the bipedal movement of the robot based at least in part on the calibration.
source_title: Methods and systems for force sensor calibration

abstract: A method for controlling motion of a two-legged robot includes: acquiring gait parameters of the two-legged robot; inputting the gait parameters to a preset gait planning model; determining gait trajectory parameters of the two-legged robot based on the gait parameters through the preset gait planning model, in which the gait trajectory parameters include a center-of-mass state corresponding to a double support phase and a center-of-mass state corresponding to a single support phase, and the center-of-mass state includes a center-of-mass position and a center-of-mass movement speed; and controlling the two-legged robot to move according to the gait trajectory parameters.
source_title: MOTION CONTROL METHOD AND TWO-LEGGED ROBOT

abstract: The invention discloses a biped robot structure. The biped robot structure comprises a hip, an upper supporting rod, a lower supporting rod, a first power mechanism, a second power mechanism and a third power mechanism. The invention further provides a control method of the biped robot structure. The control method comprises the following steps: the first power mechanism and the third power mechanism are controlled to operate for passive walking; and when a robot encounters an obstacle in the forward walking direction, the second power mechanism is controlled to operate to make the angle of the swing shaft of the lower supporting rod deflect. The second power mechanism can drive the third power mechanism to rotate at the lower end of the upper supporting rod, so the angle of the swing shaft of the lower supporting rod is changed, the lower supporting rod swings towards the left front or the right front, the lower supporting rod bypasses the obstacle from the side face of the obstacle,and the situation that the knee lifting action of the robot is interfered due to the obstacle right ahead the lower supporting rod is avoided.
source_title: Biped robot structure and control method thereof

abstract: A method for generating a gait of a two-legged walking robot having a body, two articulated legs each connected to the body through a hip joint and each including a thigh link, a crus link connected to the thigh link through a knee joint and a foot connected to the crus link through an ankle joint, the robot being configured to drive the articulated legs as a foreleg and hind leg such that the hind leg kicks ground to walk in a direction. In the method, a position of the robot body at a time when the hind leg has kicked the ground is estimated, and an amount of lift, in the direction of gravity, of a heel of the foot of the hind leg is determined such that the robot body will reach at least the estimated position. Then a vertical amplitude of the robot body trajectory is temporarily determined and is then corrected such that the vertical acceleration becomes a desired value, and the gait is then determined or generated based thereon. The robot locomotion is then controlled based on the generated gait. <IMAGE>
source_title: Method of generating gait of legged walking robot and system for controlling its locomotion

abstract:
PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a leg type mobile robot capable of securing mobile stability.

SOLUTION: This bipedal walking robot includes a foot joined to a distal end of a leg through an ankle joint. The foot includes a foot flat portion (31) having a ground contact end of the foot, a sensor fixing frame (33) joined to the ankle joint and configured to be movable in a direction perpendicular to the ground contact end of the foot with respect to the foot flat portion (31), and a shock absorbing mechanism (34) comprising a motion direction conversion mechanism and a shock absorber (51). The shock absorber (51) is disposed in a direction horizontal to the ground contact end of the foot and is coupled to the sensor fixing frame (33). The motion direction conversion mechanism is configured to convert a motion of the sensor fixing frame (33) in the direction perpendicular to a motion of the shock absorber (51) in the horizontal direction, and is equipped with a bell crank (53) and a spherical shaft (52) rotatably coupled to each of the bell crank (53) and the foot flat portion (31).

COPYRIGHT: (C)2008,JPO&INPIT
source_title: LEG TYPE MOBILE ROBOT

abstract: The invention discloses a stability adjusting method and system for passive rhythm walking of an asymmetric rimless wheel model, and the asymmetric rimless wheel model in the method is formed by the fixed connection of two rimless wheel frames with the number of spokes being n/2 at a certain relative angle, and a reachable region at the tail end of each spoke of the asymmetric rimless wheel modelis a cut region. And further the region is divided into a sub-region I, a sub-region II, a sub-region III and a sub-region IV according to different functional action rules. The final system stabilitycalculation module obtains a characteristic value used for evaluating the system stability by solving a motion equation of the system, and the final system stability active adjustment module adjuststhe final stability of the system by adjusting geometrical characteristic parameters of the model. The method has more direct and effective guiding significance for realizing stable biped walking of the foot-type robot.
source_title: Stability adjusting method and system for passive rhythm walking of asymmetric sideless wheel model

abstract: The invention provides an under-actuated flexible double-foot jumping robot which comprises a robot body and a flexible leg structure, the flexible leg structure is arranged on the robot body and comprises a hip, a thigh, a shank and a foot, one end of the hip is connected with the robot body, the other end of the hip is connected with the thigh, and the other end of the hip is connected with the foot. One end of each shank is connected with the corresponding thigh, and the other end of each shank is connected with the corresponding foot. The stepping motor is adopted as a driving source of the robot, the driving force is large, and the response speed is high; a spring and a rope in the leg structure simulate the muscle effect, the spring can play a role in buffering and damping when the robot falls to the ground and can also achieve the energy storage and release function, and the energy utilization efficiency of the robot is improved; the biped robot drives the balancing weight installed on the linear motor through the linear motor in the main body, and the gravity center position of the biped robot is adjusted, so that the robot can obtain a stable posture in the moving process.
source_title: Under-actuated flexible double-foot jumping robot

abstract: The invention provides a biped robot which comprises a mounting part, leg structures are arranged on the two sides of the mounting part respectively, each leg structure comprises a first swing mechanism, a second swing mechanism and a foot mechanism which are connected in sequence, and a first connecting part is arranged between the first swing mechanism and the second swing mechanism; a second connecting piece is arranged between the second swinging mechanism and the foot mechanism; the first swing mechanism comprises at least two parallel X swing rods, the upper ends of all the X swing rods are hinged to the mounting piece, and the lower ends of all the X swing rods are hinged to the first connecting piece. The second swing mechanism comprises at least two parallel Y swing rods, the upper ends of all the Y swing rods are hinged to the first connecting piece, and the lower ends of all the Y swing rods are hinged to the second connecting piece. The foot mechanism includes a support. According to the biped robot provided by the invention, the stability of the biped robot during advancing or retreating can be enhanced, and the biped robot can advance on a complex road surface environment.
source_title: Biped robot

abstract: The invention relates to a foot structure of a biped robot and an all-terrain pavement adaptation method thereof. When the biped robot adopting the foot structure walks on a non-flat road surface, active adaptation can be conducted according to the actual terrain of the road surface, the corresponding posture is adjusted in time, the standing and walking stability of the biped robot is rapidly andeffectively improved, and the problems, for example, that when the biped robot walks on the uneven road surface, the foot ground contact area is small, and overall balance is difficult to maintain are solved. According to the all-terrain road surface adaptive foot structure, the foot bottom is divided into four areas, and the four areas are independently stressed and deformed, so the foot of therobot is kept in good contact with the ground on the uneven road surface; and meanwhile, the situation that the foot touches the ground is obtained through the force measuring sensors distributed in the four areas of the foot, the actual topographic distribution of the foot is speculated according to the situation, related joints of the robot are driven to be adjusted, and active adaptation of thefoot and the overall posture of the robot to the uneven road surface is completed.
source_title: Foot structure of biped robot and all-terrain pavement adaptation method thereof

abstract: The invention relates to a biped robot real machine deployment method. The invention relates to the technical field of biped robot deployment, and in Sim2Real deployment, the requirements of a simulation environment and an actual environment on the control frequency reach the same control frequency; when the position q and speed dq information of the robot joints is obtained, a mode of sending batch requests and receiving asynchronous responses in a pseudo-parallel mode is adopted; in the Sim2Real process, the synchronism of the IMU data acquisition frequency and the robot control frequency is controlled; the operation performance of the robot in an actual scene is evaluated, and the ability of the robot to deal with various complex conditions is tested, so that the deployment of the real machine of the biped robot is perfected. The performance of the robot in the actual environment is improved through measures such as control frequency optimization, IMU optimization and simulation alignment.
source_title: Biped robot real machine deployment method

abstract: The invention discloses a biped robot with an obstacle crossing function. The biped robot comprises a walking device and an obstacle crossing device. The walking device comprises a vertically arranged frame, a motor arranged in the frame, an output gear connected to the motor and a transmission gear engaged with the output gear. A transmission shaft is arranged in the center of the transmission gear and mounted on a shaft frame, the two ends of the transmission shaft are each provided with a crank extending in the radial direction of the transmission shaft, and a rotating shaft vertically and outwards extends from the other end of each crank. Supporting shafts outwards extend from the two outer sides of the frame and located above the rotating shafts. The rotating shafts and the supporting shafts are located in the same vertical plane. The difference between the rotational angles of the two cranks is 180 degrees. The biped robot can flexibly walk, has the obstacle crossing function, is wide in application and has practicability.
source_title: Biped robot with obstacle crossing function

abstract: An example method may include determining a requested yaw for a body of a robot, where the biped robot comprises a foot coupled to the body via a leg. The robot may then detect, via one or more sensors, a yaw rotation of the body with respect to a ground surface, where the foot is in contact with the ground surface. Based on the detected yaw rotation of the body, the robot may determine a measured yaw for the body. The robot may also determine a target yaw for the body, where the target yaw for the body is between the measured yaw for the body and the requested yaw for the body. The robot may then cause the foot to rotate the body to the target yaw for the body.
source_title: Yaw slip handling in a robotic device

abstract: In a legged mobile robot, in particular in a biped robot, the feet position and/or posture is determined based on a distributed floor reaction force in a desired gait and a compensating floor reaction force and a detected floor reaction force. These are distributed to each of the feet such that each foot rotates respectively by predetermined angles based on a corrected position and/or posture of the foot. The robot can walk on a floor having not only a slope extending over a relatively long distance, but also existing locally. With this, it becomes possible to control the floor reaction force acting on the robot easily and properly, without causing any interference to occur. Moreover, the system can ensure to control the floor reaction force acting on the robot properly, even when walking on the floor having not only a slant or undulation extending over a relatively long distance. Furthermore, the system can achieve the posture stabilization control of a legged mobile robot easily, decrease the impact acting on the legged mobile robot at foot landing, and enhance the contactability with the floor so as to prevent the slippage or spinning at walking from happening. In addition, the system can decrease the load of the actuators of the legged mobile robot.
source_title: Control system of legged mobile robot

abstract: A system for generating or determining a desired height of a biped mobile robot (1) having a body (24) and two articulated legs (2) each connected to the body (24) through a hip joint (10-14) and each including a knee joint (16), an ankle joint (18,20) and a foot (22). In the system, body trajectory of body displacement including desired horizontal body position and orientation, except for a desired body height in the direction of gravity, and leg trajectory of foot displacement including a desired position and orientation, are predetermined on an off-line computer. Based on the parameters, a body height in the direction of gravity is determined by solving an equation comprised of a continuous function of the body height. Then, desired angles of said hip joints (10-14), said knee joint (16) and said ankle joint (18,20) are determined, through an inverse kinematic solution, based on said determination body trajectory, said leg trajectory and said determined desired body height. With the arrangement, it becomes possible to determine a smooth body height trajectory appropriately reduced in vertical motion on a real time basis during robot locomotion. <IMAGE>
source_title: System for and method of generating a gait of a legged mobile robot

abstract: The invention discloses a planning method for the diagonal gait of a quadruped robot based on dual generating functions. According to the planning method, the method of generating functions is appliedto optimal online gait generation of the quadruped robot. A virtual leg technology is applied, a model for the diagonal gait of the quadruped robot is made equivalent to a biped model, and then a kinetic model of the quadruped robot is simplified through derivation of a Lagrange energy method and is then subjected to linear processing. A cost function is established to transform gait planning into an optimal control problem of solving finite time linear quadratic type, and a dual generating function algorithm is utilized for conducting solving to obtain the optimal state and optimal input. The planning method is used for controlling the diagonal gait of the quadruped robot. By using the dual generating function method to conduct solving, a large number of complicated differential equationcomputing processes can be carried out offline, and the planning method has the advantages that the online planning efficiency is high, and different boundary conditions can be planned.
source_title: Planning method for diagonal gait of quadruped robot based on dual generating functions

abstract: A rigid-flexible coupled leg structure of a biped robot comprises a trunk module, a hip joint module, a thigh module, a shank module and a foot module which are sequentially connected from top to bottom. Shock absorbers are connected between the thigh module and the shank module and between the shank module and the foot module. The compact design of the leg structure is realized through the series layout of the motor and the reasonable integration of key parts; meanwhile, a four-connecting-rod driving mechanism is introduced, so that the joint torque transmission efficiency and the overall movement performance are improved; and on the premise of ensuring the light weight of the system, the stability and response capability of the robot in dynamic actions such as walking and take-off are effectively enhanced.
source_title: Rigid-flexible coupled leg structure of biped robot

abstract: The invention discloses a modular joint of a biped robot. The joint comprises a speed reducer, a hollow motor, an input shaft, a motor encoder, a joint output encoder and a motor driving plate. On thepremise that design parameter requirements are met, due to the fact that the number of joints of the biped robot is large, in order to meet the maximum torque/weight parameter and give considerationto the feasibility of production and manufacturing, a hollow motor bearing and a speed reducer are shared, and a motor rotor output shaft and a speed reducer input shaft are shared at the same time, therefore, the transmission connection precision of the motor and the speed reducer is higher. A plurality of functions are integrated in one joint, so that the torque/weight value is increased; the structure is more compact, the assembly links are reduced, and the assembly positioning precision is higher; the use of one bearing is reduced, so that the friction loss is smaller, and the sensitivityof the current monitoring feedback torque is higher.
source_title: Modular joint of biped robot

abstract: The invention discloses a biped robot and a leg damping and energy recovery device thereof, and relates to the technical field of robots. An energy recovery mechanism comprises a left foot assembly, a right foot assembly, a magnetic wire cutting coil and a coil driving assembly, energy recovery magnets are arranged on the two opposite inner side faces of an annular base of the left foot assembly and the right foot assembly, the coil driving assembly is rotationally connected to the inner bottom of the annular base, and the magnetic wire cutting coil is clamped to the top of the coil driving assembly; transmission structures are engaged with the surfaces of the tooth columns of the left and right foot assemblies and used for driving the coil driving assemblies to rotate. When the biped robot walks, the vibration of the feet drives the tooth columns to move up and down, under the cooperation of the tooth columns and the second transmission gear and the cooperation of the first transmission gear and the gear ring, forward and reverse rotation of the coil driving assembly is achieved, and magnetic induction lines are cut by the magnetic line cutting coil; vibration energy of walking of the biped robot is effectively converted into electric energy to be stored for the robot to use.
source_title: Biped robot and leg damping and energy recovery device thereof

abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of bionic robots, and particularly relates to a biped robot. In the biped robot, leg structures are arranged on an upper body frame in pairs at an interval. In one leg structure, a first steering engine and a second steering engine are arranged on the upper body frame in parallel at an interval, the first steering engine can drive a first rocker to swing so as to drive a first connecting rod, the second steering engine can drive a second rocker to swing so as to drive a second connecting rod, a supporting leg pivoted with the first connecting rod and the second connecting rod is driven, and the supporting leg can provide an enough supporting effect. The leg structures are simple, and the whole robot is small in mass. According to the biped robot, the first steering engines and the second steering engines which are large in mass are arranged on the upper body frame, parts, except for the first steering engines and the second steering engines,of the leg structures are small in mass relative to an upper body part, the overall mass center of the robot is adjusted to the upper body part, inertia of the leg structures in the working process is reduced, and the influence on the posture of the robot is reduced; and requirements for a walking stability control algorithm are reduced, and required driving force is reduced so as to reduce powerconsumption of the steering engines.
source_title: Biped robot

abstract: The invention provides a two-foot walking robot, belongs to the technical field of robots, and aims at solving the problems that most existing biped walking robots are single in walking mode and poor in stability, and a stable platform cannot be provided for scientific research equipment. The two-foot walking robot includes a control unit, a head platform, a ball-like joint, an abdomen unit and leg units symmetrically arranged on the abdomen unit at intervals, wherein the control unit is fixed on the head platform; and the two ends of the ball-like joint are fixedly connected with the head platform and the abdomen unit respectively. According to the design, a platform which is convenient to modify and highly modularized is provided, so that highly free overall control can be provided at the same time so as to meet the requirements of various users; when the robot walks, the body is close to the ground, and the head can be lifted up; due to a large number of joints, the robot has the functions of self-calibration, tumble and standing; even under complex and changeable terrains, the robot can provide a stable and free operation platform for scientific instruments.
source_title: Two-foot walking robot

abstract: The invention provides a biped robot motion planning method, device and equipment and a storage medium, and the method comprises the steps: obtaining a discrete map with topographic information corresponding to a to-be-walked region, determining topographic points representing that a biped robot is allowed to pass through in the discrete map, and generating a preliminary foothold point sequence; generating a preliminary motion track of the biped robot based on the discrete map; and based on a preset objective function, optimizing the preliminary foothold sequence according to the preliminary motion track and a preset kinematics model of the biped robot, and generating a target foothold sequence, so that the biped robot executes the target foothold sequence to complete motion. The method comprises the following steps of: judging whether a position can pass or serve as a foothold of the biped robot according to gradient information of ground height in a discrete map by utilizing kinematics characteristics of the biped robot, and performing parameter optimization on the foothold to obtain a target foothold sequence; therefore, the biped robot can complete the crossing task more efficiently in combination with the topographic characteristics.
source_title: Biped robot motion planning method, device and equipment and storage medium

abstract: The present disclosure relates to robot technology, which provides a gait control method, device, and terminal device for a biped robot. The method includes: planning an initial position of an ankle joint of the biped robot and a rotation angle of a sole of the biped robot to rotate around one of a toe and a heel of the biped robot; planning a body pose of the biped robot; calculating a target position of the ankle joint based on the initial position of the ankle joint and the rotation angle of the sole; obtaining a joint angle of each of a plurality of joints of the biped robot by performing an operation on the body pose and the target position of the ankle joint utilizing an inverse kinematics algorithm; and adjusting a gait of the biped robot based on the joint angle of each of the joints.
source_title: Gait control method, device, and terminal device for biped robot

abstract: The invention discloses a bipedal walking robot based on a parallel mechanism. The bipedal walking robot comprises a waist platform and two leg part mechanisms symmetrically arranged and connected tothe lower side of the waist platform. Each leg part mechanism comprises an upper platform, a lower platform and three telescopic cylinders hinged between the upper platform and the lower platform through universal joints, and the bipedal walking robot further comprises a steering mechanism installed on the waist platform and a sole mechanism installed at the bottom of each leg part mechanism. According to the bipedal walking robot based on the parallel mechanism, a single-degree-of-freedom waist part is used for driving a motor to drive two three-degree-of-freedom leg part mechanisms based ona parallel structure, so that under the situation that two legs are only provided with four degrees of freedom in total, the robot can realize the functions of straight running, turning, obstacle-crossing and walking up and down stairs stably; and compared with existing six-degree-of-freedom robots, the design structure of the robot is simpler, a workspace is large, and the payload to deadweight ratio is high.
source_title: Bipedal walking robot based on parallel mechanism

abstract: The invention discloses a biped walking robot with a single hip joint driving function; the key points of the technical scheme comprise that the biped walking robot comprises a waist support, a control box is mounted on the lower surface of the waist support, and the inner walls of the left end and the right end of the lower surface of the waist support are connected with a first hip joint assembly and a second hip joint assembly respectively; the lower portion of the first hip joint assembly and the lower portion of the second hip joint assembly are connected with a first thigh assembly and a second thigh assembly respectively, the first thigh assembly and the second thigh assembly are connected with a first shank assembly and a second shank assembly respectively, and foot assemblies are arranged on the first shank assembly and the second shank assembly. The biped walking robot with the single hip joint driving function is provided with a hip joint driving mechanism, has one hip joint freedom degree and two knee joint freedom degrees, can achieve biped walking by means of three freedom degrees, and is simple in structure and low in cost.
source_title: Biped walking robot with single hip joint driving function

abstract: A biped robot with the safety patrol function comprises a left side foot system, a right side foot system, a supporting wheel system, a rack and a camera system. The left side foot system comprises eleven left side rods 1-11, a left foot and a left motor. The right side foot system comprises eleven right side rods 1-11, a right foot and a right motor; and the left motor and the right motor respectively drive the left side rod and the right side rod to realize forward stepping of the left foot and the right foot. The robot has high obstacle crossing performance, the stability of the robot in the moving process can be improved through the supporting wheel system, and the robot can be suitable for an unstructured rugged environment.
source_title: Biped robot with safety patrol function

abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of robots, and discloses a biped robot mass distribution method. The biped robot mass distribution method comprises the steps that lower limb mass parameters are obtained; obtaining a first vector of the lower limb mass center relative to the waist center according to the lower limb mass parameters; determining a second vector of the upper limb centroid relative to the waist center according to the first vector of the lower limb centroid relative to the waist center; if the second vector meets the preset condition, obtaining upper limb longitudinal coordinates of the upper limb mass center relative to the waist center; the upper limbs are movably arranged relative to the waist center based on upper limb longitudinal coordinates of the upper limb mass centers relative to the waist center. By adopting the biped robot mass distribution method, the matching degree of the upper limbs and the lower limbs of the biped robot can be improved, and the balance control difficulty of the robot in the movement process is reduced. The invention further discloses the biped robot.
source_title: Biped robot mass distribution method and biped robot

abstract: A system for controlling locomotion of a biped walking robot. The system is constituted to carry out feedback control for eliminating the deviation between the target value and the detected angle of inclination of the linkage mechanism in the absolute coordinate system, stable dynamic walking can be ensured at all times even during locomotion over rough terrain. In the stability control, the number of joints with respect to which control is conducted is reduced to the minimum required and control is conducted separately but in coordination with respect to the movement or motion in the pitch direction and the movement or motion in the roll direction, while the remaining joints are subjected locally. Thus, the control is considerably simplified. In addition, feedback control is conducted with respect to the velocity components so as to realize the desired posture angles and the feedback gain adjusted so as to achieve the response speed required by the individual linkages. This further enhances the capability of the robot to walk stably at high speed. <IMAGE>
source_title: System for controlling locomotion of legged walking robot.

abstract: When an operator attempts to move a robot from a current position to a desired position, she/he operates a manipulator lever 26 corresponding to a desired direction of a manipulator 23 of a remote control device 22, for example, a number of times corresponding to a predetermined moving amount in the moving direction. At this point, the moving amount for each moving direction depending on this number of operations is set, and a leg of the robot is actuated according to a setting value of the moving amount for each moving direction to move the robot. The moving amount that can be set by the operation of the manipulator lever 26 has a relatively small moving amount that the robot may be moved by performing a lifting/landing action once for both the legs of the robot, and a relatively large moving amount requiring multiple walking steps of the lifting/landing action for each leg of the robot. The movement of the bipedal mobile robot to the desired position may surely be carried out by a relatively simple operation. <IMAGE>
source_title: Remote control device of bipedal mobile robot

abstract: A method of controlling walking a biped robot to generate a walking pattern maximally similar to that of a human includes generating a walking pattern, calculating a walking pattern similarity corresponding to the walking pattern, and comparing the walking pattern similarity with a predetermined reference pattern similarity, and changing the walking pattern based on a result of the comparison. When the robot walks, a knee is maximally stretched and a horizontal movement of a waist is minimized such that the walking pattern of the robot is maximally similar to that of a human, thus enhancing an affinity for a human being and increasing energy efficiency.
source_title: Robot and method of controlling walking thereof

abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of robot walking control, and particularly relates to a flat ground walking method of a biped robot with an upper body based on serial elastic drivers. The method comprises the steps that the serial elastic drivers are arranged between the upper body and double legs of the biped robot with the upper body respectively and formed by connecting motors and linear torsion springs in series; the hip serial elastic driver supports the upper body and also achieves the energy supplementing with elastic potential energy as media, and the robot is driven to walk; the swinging leg landing collision and the driving stage time duration serve as events, and every walking step of the robot is divided into two drive stages and one free swinging stage in sequence; a state machine driven by the events controls the action of the serial elastic drivers, and walking is controlled; and the walking state of the robot can reach the preset target through adjustment on the preset motor driving angle amplitude, the driving stage time duration and the spring elastic coefficient.
source_title: Flat ground walking method of biped robot with upper body based on serial elastic drivers
