abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of biped robots, in particular to a biped robot foot damping device which comprises a foot body, the foot body comprises a foot upper portion and a foot lower portion which are arranged up and down, a foot front damping assembly and a foot rear damping assembly are arranged between the foot upper portion and the foot lower portion, and an edge warping portion is integrally formed at the front end of the foot lower portion; the foot front damping assembly comprises a supporting protruding block integrally formed with the upper portion of the foot, a supporting protruding ridge integrally formed with the lower portion of the foot, and a carbon plate fixedly arranged between the supporting protruding block and the supporting protruding ridge and connected with the edge warping portion in a clamped mode. The foot rear damping assembly comprises a first sleeve, a first limiting plate, a second sleeve, a second limiting plate and an elastic element. The damping foot is compact in structure, the front-foot damping assembly and the rear-foot damping assembly serve as elastic connection between the upper foot portion and the lower foot portion, the buffering and damping capacity of the foot body is remarkably improved, and the front-foot damping assembly and the rear-foot damping assembly are easy to install and maintain.
source_title: Foot damping device of biped robot

abstract: A robotic system where a pair of legs is configured such that a knee joint can rotate continuously 360 degrees around an axis. The upper body connects to a pair of legs each including an upper portion and a lower portion. One end of the lower portion of each leg connects to a hip joint. A knee joint in each leg has one degree of freedom around an axis where the knee joint can rotate 360 degrees around the axis. Control circuitry can be housed in the upper body for providing bipedal movement by activating actuators in hip joints and knee joints.
source_title: CONTINUOUS ROBOTIC KNEE JOINT SYSTEM

abstract: The invention provides a biped robot landing detection device and method based on non-force sensing, and belongs to the technical field of robots. Wherein the six-connecting-rod transmission mechanism comprises a first rotating shaft, a second rotating shaft, a third rotating shaft, a fourth rotating shaft, a first motor, a second motor, a connecting rod 1, a connecting rod 2, a connecting rod 3, a connecting rod 4, a connecting rod 5, a connecting rod 6, a third rotating shaft encoder and a fourth rotating shaft encoder, the connecting rods are sequentially connected in pairs to form a closed chain structure, and the connecting rod 5 is designed into an elastic structure. Therefore, the service life of the robot is prolonged and the detection reliability is improved.
source_title: Biped robot landing detection device and method based on non-force sensing

abstract: The invention provides a robot sensing terrain recognition gait control method and system, a medium and equipment, and belongs to the technical field of robot sensing. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring pitch angle data and plantar force data of the biped robot on the basis of optimal plantar force; inputting the pitch angle data and the plantar force data into a trained KNN model, and identifying the current walking terrain of the robot to obtain a terrain identification result; the training process of the KNN model comprises the steps that the biped robot is driven to pass through a rugged terrain and a flat terrain in a fixed stride frequency gait mode, pitch angle sample data and plantar force sample data passing through different terrains are collected and input into the KNN model, and the KNN model is used for conducting terrain classification; and the robot controller receives a terrain recognition result, and adjusts the stride frequency and the gait of the robot according to a preset gait control strategy based on the result. According to the method, an additional sensor does not need to be added to the robot, and the terrain can be identified only through state feedback of the robot.
source_title: Robot-perceived terrain recognition gait control method, system, medium and equipment

abstract: The invention discloses a seven-connecting-rod biped robot building method and a hybrid control method based on ZMP and CPG, and belongs to the field of artificial intelligence and robot control. The invention designs a small biped robot, the robot comprises a control module, a driving module, a sensor module and a power supply module, and has the characteristics that the open source property is strong, a bottom layer drive can be built by the robot, and environmental perception can be fully performed, and the ZMP and CPG hybrid control method is provided based on the robot. The zero moment point of the robot is measured and calculated through a pressure sensor module of the robot, the deviation between an actual zero moment point and an expected zero moment point serves as compensation and is fed back to open-loop CPG control, closed-loop control of the system is achieved, and walking stability is improved. According to the invention, the biped robot can have higher open source performance and environment perception capability, and the hybrid control method can enable the robot to realize closed-loop control of a robot walking system on the premise of avoiding huge calculated amount.
source_title: Design of seven-connecting-rod biped robot and hybrid control method based on ZMP and CPG

abstract: A servo system for controlling locomotion of a biped walking robot, made up of a body link and two leg linkages each connected to the body link by a first drive joint and each including knee and ankle joints, to follow up a target angle for each drive joint predetermined in series with respect to time such that the robot walks. In order to stabilize robot posture when it could turn over, the drive speed of the joints are feedback controlled in responsive with the robot turnover probability. Moreover, the predetermined robot gait is modified at such instance, for example, in such a manner that robot leg lands one of additionally preestablished candidate positions for robot leg landing. <IMAGE>
source_title: System for controlling locomotion of legged walking robot

abstract: The invention belongs to the field of biped robots, and particularly relates to a biped robot adopting a wheel-track transformation wheel system and a working method thereof.The biped robot adopting the wheel-track transformation wheel system comprises a robot body and mechanical legs arranged on the two sides of the robot body; the mechanical leg comprises a rotating arm I, a rotating arm II and a wheel-track deformation wheel system, according to the biped robot adopting the wheel-track deformation wheel system, the wheel-track deformation wheel system is arranged at the end of the rotating arm II, wheel-track deformation wheels are well fused with the two feet of the biped robot, and therefore the wheel-track deformation wheel system is formed; five working modes including a deformation rim revolution driving mode, a caterpillar band driving mode, a self-adaptive driving mode, a braking mode and a leg type driving mode can be switched.
source_title: Biped robot adopting wheel-track transformation wheel system and working method of biped robot

abstract: The invention discloses a biped robot gait control method and a biped robot. The method comprises the steps of obtaining six-dimensional force information, and judging a supporting state of the bipedrobot according to the six-dimensional force information; calculating the ZMP position of each foot of the biped robot according to the six-dimensional force information; setting a ZMP expected valueof each foot according to the supporting state and a body posture error; determining an ankle joint compensation angle of each foot of the biped robot according to the ZMP position, the change rate ofthe ZMP position, the ZMP expected value and the change rate of the ZMP expected value; tracking and adjusting the current ankle joint angle of the biped robot in real time according to the ankle joint compensation angle; and circulating the steps at a set frequency until posture control or ankle joint compliance is completed in different supporting states.
source_title: Biped robot gait control method and biped robot

abstract: The invention relates to the field of robots, in particular to a modularized double-wheel-foot robot with parallel spines and a control method of the modularized double-wheel-foot robot. The overall structure of the modularized biped robot with the spine is composed of a spine assembly, a trunk assembly and mechanical leg assemblies. The control framework is composed of a spine control module, a wheel foot motion control module and a robot combination cooperative control module. The spine is composed of a parallel structure, the degree of freedom of the robot is increased, higher flexibility is achieved, meanwhile, the spine and the trunk can rotate around the mechanical legs, splicing of various forms of robots such as a double-wheel-foot robot, a bionic four-wheel-foot robot, a side-by-side four-wheel-foot robot and a multi-wheel-foot robot can be achieved, and the applicability of the robot is improved.
source_title: Modularized double-wheel-foot robot with spine and control method of modularized double-wheel-foot robot

abstract: The invention discloses a hydraulic biped robot without an external power source. The hydraulic biped robot comprises a small-scale hydraulic power station, a hip platform, an oil division group, a left leg and a right leg. The small-scale hydraulic power station is integrated to the hydraulic biped robot, so that the robot is not restricted during the outdoor activities, the advantages of the hydraulic biped robot can be well realized during the field operation; an experiment verification result shows that the pump station is capable of supply sufficient pressure to the normal walking of therobot, the robot can work for 30 minutes under a full-loading condition and can meet the demands on the basic debugging and operation; meanwhile, hydraulic oil of the small-scale hydraulic power station is mainly in a pipeline of the pump station, an oil storage mechanism is mainly used for injecting hydraulic oil, and only a small amount of hydraulic oil is stored, so that the volume and mass ofthe pump station are relatively small, and the pump station can be conveniently integrated to the biped robot. Besides, after the pump station is integrated to the robot, a complete closed-loop systemis formed, and the situation that the robot is disturbed by an external pump station connecting pipeline during the operation can be avoided.
source_title: Hydraulic biped robot without external power source

abstract: Disclosed is a method of defining control angles to use a limit cycle in order to balance a biped walking robot on a three-dimensional space. In order to balance an FSM-based biped walking robot right and left on a three-dimensional space, limit cycle control angles to balance the robot according to states of the FSM-based robot are set on the three-dimensional space, and the limit cycle control angles on the three-dimensional space are controlled using a sinusoidal function to allow relations between the control angles and control angular velocities to form a stable closed loop within a limit cycle.
source_title: Robot and method of controlling the same

abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of robot control, and discloses a biped robot balance control method and a biped robot. The balance control method of the biped robot comprises the steps that when the ground inclines, head IMU information, shank IMU information and hip IMU information of the biped robot are obtained, and then front-back balance adjustment and left-right balance adjustment are conducted on the biped robot at the same time according to the obtained IMU information of the biped robot. The biped robot applies the balance control method of the biped robot. Through simultaneous front-back balance control and left-right balance control, the balance of the biped robot in the front-back direction and the left-right direction can be ensured, so that the biped robot reaches a new balance state when standing and walking on various uneven grounds; therefore, the positions of the COM and the ZMP are always located in a polygonal area defined by the contact of the foot surfaces of the biped robot and the ground, and the walking stability and the environment adaptability of the biped robot are effectively improved.
source_title: Balance control method of biped robot and biped robot

abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of robots, in particular to a double-foot-wheel robot and a control method thereof. The double-foot-wheel robot comprises a control module and a control module, the angle sensor is connected with the control module; the servo motor unit is connected with the control module; the main connecting rod unit is connected with the servo motor unit; one end of the auxiliary connecting rod unit is movably connected with the main connecting rod unit; the hub motor unit is connected with the auxiliary connecting rod unit, and the hub motor unit is in communication connection with the control module; the hub unit is connected with the hub motor unit; wherein the control module is used for controlling the servo motor unit to adjust the posture of the biped wheel robot, or controlling the hub motor unit to drive the hub unit to enable the biped wheel robot to move to a destination. The energy consumption of the robot can be reduced, and the flexibility and the complex terrain adaptability are improved.
source_title: Biped wheel robot and control method thereof

abstract: Provided is a walking control method enabling stable walking operation to be realized, a walking control program and a biped walking robot. A walking control method includes, during walking operation of a biped walking robot having a position of center of gravity being adjusted at a predetermined reference angle that enables the robot to be upright, a step of acquiring information indicative of an inclination angle of an upper body relative to the reference angle, and a step of operating, with one of a first leg and a second leg not being grounded due to the walking operation, the first leg and the second leg such that the upper body is maintained within a predetermined angle range relative to the reference angle according to the inclination angle.
source_title: WALKING CONTROL METHOD, WALKING CONTROL PROGRAM AND BIPED WALKING ROBOT

abstract: The invention discloses a single-foot support phase gait planning method of a biped robot. According to the method, the landing time of an underactuated free robot is estimated on the basis of a simplified model, possible landing time errors are further considered, the robot is made to move to a target pose in advance, and then the pose is kept for landing; besides, in order to prevent the robot swinging foot from scraping the ground, the method decomposes the action process of swinging the leg by the single-foot support, which comprises leg lifting action and leg swinging action. Based on thesingle-foot support phase gait planning method provided by the invention, the robot can be effectively helped to reach an expected foothold in the single-foot support phase and can be prevented frombeing scraped with the ground, so that the walking movement and task operation of the biped robot are favorably realized.
source_title: Single-foot support phase gait planning method of biped robot

abstract: The invention discloses a parallel straight-knee biped robot driven by artificial muscles, and relates to the technical field of bionic biped robots. The problems that an existing biped robot is bloated in structure, large in weight and insufficient in driving force are solved. The robot comprises a hip part (1) driven by a rotational joint motor, a leg part (2) driven by artificial muscles and a foot part (3). And the two rotational joint motors are respectively connected with one leg and the hip. Each leg is composed of two four-branch-chain 2R1T three-degree-of-freedom parallel mechanisms sharing the static platform, each 2R1T parallel mechanism is driven by four artificial muscles, and each leg is totally provided with eight artificial muscles serving as driving elements. The two 2R1T parallel mechanism movable platforms are connected with the hip and the feet of the robot respectively. The robot foot is a large rigid flat plate and is used for stabilizing the robot. The size is small, the weight is light, and the robot motion inertia is reduced. The method is used for occasions of man-machine interaction or collaborative operation with human beings.
source_title: Parallel straight-knee biped robot driven by artificial muscles

abstract: The invention relates to a lower limb structure of a two-leg robot, which belongs to the field of robot. Applying the characteristics of mechanical movement of parallel opposite sides in a parallel four-link, the invention designs the lower limb structure of the robot with two legs having ten degrees of freedom. Compared with the lower limb structure of the general two-leg robot having 12 degreesof freedom, two degrees of freedom of forward swinging on two ankle joints are decreased. In connection with the opposite driving method with two motors and the same axle applied by each forward swinging and sideward swinging, the invention increases a joint driving torque and decreases the rotation clearance when the mechanism is kept compact. Besides, two motors which realize the degrees of freedom of forward swinging on hip and knee joints are both designed and arranged at the knee joints, thus optimizing the quality distribution of leg mechanisms and reducing the design difficulty of the hip joints with 3 degrees of freedom. The invention uses the parallel four-link mechanism to realize the mechanism design of upper legs and lower legs of the robot, so bottoms of the two feet of the robot are always parallel with the ground during walking, and the effect on the walking stability of the robot due to the rotation clearance of output shafts of the motors is effectively decreased.
source_title: Lower limb mechanism of biped robot

abstract: The invention provides a biped magnetic adsorption wall-climbing robot. The biped magnetic adsorption wall-climbing robot comprises a first adsorption foot assembly, a waist turning joint assembly, afirst pitching joint assembly, a second pitching joint assembly, a third pitching joint assembly, a connecting rod III, a second adsorption foot assembly, a control system, a wireless module and a power supply device and can be used for detecting iron wall surfaces such as large-sized tank bodies, ship surface bodies and steel framed bridge towers. By controlling coordinated motion of each joint assembly and alternate adsorptions between the two adsorption foot assemblies and the wall surface, the circumferential motion, creeping, turnover and crossed surface transition of the robot are realized. The robot can detect the characteristics of the wall surface by using a camera and transmit images to a user. The robot can also execute different types of operations by mounting different terminal devices. The biped magnetic adsorption wall-climbing robot has the advantages of compact structure, multiple functions and crossed surface transition capacity. A solution is provided to assist people or replace people to carry out operations such as overhauling under dangerous environments such as vertical wall surfaces or high altitude wall surfaces.
source_title: Biped magnetic adsorption wall-climbing robot

abstract: The invention belongs to the related technical field of hydraulic robot body structure design, and discloses a hydraulic biped robot thigh plate and a hydraulic biped robot, a hydraulic oil transmission channel is formed in the thigh plate, and the hydraulic oil transmission channel is embedded in the thigh plate; a plurality of heat dissipation through holes are formed in the thigh plate at intervals, so that a heat dissipation grid is formed in the area, where the heat dissipation through holes are formed, of the thigh plate. A non-pipe mode is adopted for providing a channel for transmission of hydraulic oil among the waist, the thighs and the shanks, the length of a single hose is shortened, the structural complexity of a hose connector is reduced, the influence of the hose on the motion reliability of the robot is reduced, and the overall structure of the legs is more concise and ordered.
source_title: Thigh plate of hydraulic biped robot and hydraulic biped robot

abstract: The invention discloses a biped semi-passive bipartition upper body walking robot which comprises a hip and two legs. The hip comprises a hip support and two lateral swinging parts, the lateral swinging parts are rotatably mounted on the hip support in a matched manner, a lateral swinging drive mechanism is arranged on the hip support, rotating parts are arranged on the lower portions of the lateral swinging parts respectively, a first rotating shaft is arranged on each rotating part and matched with the corresponding lateral swinging part, leg expansion drive mechanisms are arranged among the hip and the rotating parts, each leg comprises a thigh, a shank and an imitation foot plate, second rotating shafts are arranged on the rotating parts, thigh connectors are arranged at the upper end of the thighs and rotatably sleeve the second rotating shafts in a matched manner, front and back swinging drive mechanisms are arranged on the rotating parts, the shanks are hinged to the thighs, a knee joint drive mechanism is arranged between each thigh and the corresponding shank, the imitation foot plates are rotatably mounted at the bottoms of the shanks through ankle joint rotating shafts in a matched manner, the ankle joint rotating shafts are parallel to the second rotating shafts, and ankle joint drive mechanisms are arranged among the imitation foot plates and the hip or the legs.
source_title: Biped semi-passive bipartition upper body walking robot

abstract: The invention discloses a stepping mechanical leg capable of being used for a biped obstacle crossing robot, and belongs to the field of stepping robots. The stepping mechanical leg comprises two setsof mechanical single legs which are rotationally arranged on a robot body and are completely the same in structure. Each mechanical single leg comprises a connecting rod thigh with the upper end rotationally arranged on the robot body and a walking shank hinged to the lower end of the connecting rod thigh. The connecting rod thigh comprises a thigh top plate, a connecting rod A, a connecting rodB, a connecting rod C, a connecting rod D, connecting rod springs, lifting rods, anti-compression springs, steel wire ropes A and steel wire ropes B; the walking shank comprises a shank rod, a lockingplate, a motor B, a lead screw and a nut; a torsion spiral spring B is arranged between the sole plate and the shank rod, and torsional elastic deformation occurs when the shank moves forwards. The stepping mechanical leg is simple and reasonable in structure, capable of achieving gravity center translation during stepping to improve stepping stability, capable of crossing obstacles and capable of being used for a biped obstacle crossing robot.
source_title: Stepping mechanical leg capable of being used for biped obstacle crossing robot

abstract: An example implementation includes determining a force allocation for at least one foot of a legged robotic device, where the legged robotic device includes two feet coupled to two legs extending from a body of the legged robotic device. The implementation also includes determining a change in mass distribution of the legged robotic device, and based on the determined change in mass distribution, determining a force and a torque on the body of the legged robotic device with respect to a ground surface. The implementation also includes updating the determined force allocation for the at least one foot of the two feet based on the determined force and torque. The implementation also includes causing the at least one foot to act on the ground surface based on the updated force allocation.
source_title: Adaptive response to load

abstract: A robotic platform for traversing and manipulating a modular 3D lattice structure is described. The robot is designed specifically for its tasks within a structured environment, and is simplified in terms of its numbers of degrees of freedom (DOF). This allows for simpler controls and a reduction of mass and cost. Designing the robot relative to the environment in which it operates results in a specific type of robot called a “relative robot”. Depending on the task and environment, there can be a number of relative robots. This invention describes a bipedal robot which can locomote across a periodic lattice structure made of building block parts. The robot is able to handle, manipulate, and transport these blocks when there is more than one robot. Based on a general inchworm design, the robot has added functionality while retaining minimal complexity, and can perform numerous maneuvers for increased speed, reach, and placement.
source_title: Bipedal isotropic lattice locomoting explorer: robotic platform for locomotion and manipulation of discrete lattice structures and lightweight space structures

abstract: The invention discloses an environment-friendly agricultural intelligent robot. The environment-friendly agricultural intelligent robot comprises a frame, wherein a traveling device is arranged on theframe; the traveling device comprises a traveling motor arranged in the frame, an output gear connected to the traveling motor, a transmission gear meshed with the output gear and two feet, wherein the center of the transmission gear is provided with a transmission shaft; the transmission shaft is arranged on the shaft frame; the shaft frame is arranged on the frame; and two ends of the transmission shaft are respectively provided with a group of planetary gear devices, the planetary gear device comprises a planet wheel, a sun wheel fixedly arranged on the transmission shaft and a disc rotatably arranged on the transmission shaft, wherein a gear ring is arranged on the disc, and the planet wheel is respectively meshed with the sun wheel and the ring gear. The walking device controls the alternating movement of the feet by means of planetary gear devices, so that the robot can continuously move forwards and smoothly, the structure is simple, the design is reasonable, and the motion reliability is high.
source_title: Environment-friendly agricultural intelligent robot

abstract: The invention discloses a bionic biped robot with variable rigidity joints and double-joint flexibility, which comprises a trunk, thighs, variable rigidity knee joints, shanks and feet, and the double-joint flexible part of each leg is driven by three elastic drivers connected in series; a front-side linear motor of the rigidity-variable knee joint is rotationally connected to a mounting frame at the lower end of the thigh, and an output shaft of the front-side linear motor is connected with one end of an L-shaped connecting piece; the rear-side linear motor is mounted on the mounting frame, an output shaft of the rear-side linear motor is sequentially sleeved with a rear-side shell, a rear-side spring and a front-side shell and then fixed to the output end connecting piece, and the two sides of the rear-side spring make contact with the rear-side shell and the output end connecting piece respectively; a rope is led out from the tail end of the front side shell, is wound on a rear side shaft and a knee joint shaft in sequence, penetrates through two pairs of rollers and is fixed on a knee joint output shaft; the rollers are installed at the other ends of the L-shaped connecting pieces, and the knee joint shaft is connected with the switching parts of the two L-shaped connecting pieces through bearings. The robot has good stability, flexibility and adaptability.
source_title: Bionic biped robot with variable-rigidity joints and double-joint flexibility

abstract: The invention discloses a seven-degree-of-freedom series-parallel structure mechanical arm for a biped robot, and relates to the field of robots, the seven-degree-of-freedom series-parallel structure mechanical arm is installed on a supporting body, and the supporting body is located on an installation fixing base. Comprising a five-degree-of-freedom series arm and a two-degree-of-freedom parallel wrist structure which is located at the front end of the series arm and connected with the series arm. According to the mechanical arm with the series-parallel connection structure, the rigidity and the bearing capacity of the mechanical arm are improved, the working space is expanded to adapt to more complex operation tasks, the stability and the reliability of operation are enhanced, error accumulation is reduced, and the accuracy of overall operation is improved.
source_title: Seven-degree-of-freedom series-parallel structure mechanical arm for biped robot

abstract: The invention particularly relates to a biped robot which comprises a crotch part and two leg parts located on the left side and the right side of the crotch part and further comprises at least one set of knee joint driving module and at least one set of ankle joint driving module which can be self-locked. Each leg part comprises a thigh part, a knee joint, a shank part, an ankle joint and a foot part which are connected in sequence. Hip joints are arranged between the thigh parts and the crotch for connection. Two ends of the knee joint driving module are respectively connected with the thigh part and the shank part and control the thigh part and the shank part to rotate relatively. Two ends of the ankle joint driving module are connected with the shank part and the foot part respectively, and control the shank part and the foot part to rotate relatively. The knee joint driving module and the ankle joint driving module are self-locked and static when the legs of the biped robot are powered off, the original posture of the biped robot is effectively kept, the biped robot is prevented from falling down, and the safety is improved. The problems that in the prior art, when a robot is in the state of insufficient power or sudden power failure, joints of the robot can be immediately parked and fall down or lie down, and the safety implicit problem that people are hit or objects are damaged exists are solved.
source_title: Biped robot

abstract: The invention relates to a brimless wheel mechanism capable of being used for traveling simulation and automatic testing of a biped robot. The brimless wheel mechanism is composed of a center shaft module, a sliding sleeve module, a leg module, a control circuit module, a center shaft connection module and an additional function module, and can move in various modes under cooperation of the modules. As for the spatial bilateral brimless wheel movement mode of the brimless wheel mechanism, through intermittent impact contact between the tail end of a spoke of the brimless wheel mechanism and the topographical slope, sole rhythmic movement of a steady foot walking gait is simulated, and testing is conducted. Compared with traditional brimless wheel mechanisms and application thereof, the brimless wheel mechanism has the advantages that the number of legs can be changed, the wheel tread and the leg length can be adjusted, an elastic damping element is additionally arranged, the plane unilateral brimless wheel system mode and the spatial bilateral brimless wheel system mode can be switched, and accordingly, biped passive movement testing and control research with more forms is achieved.
source_title: Brimless wheel mechanism used for traveling simulation and automatic testing of biped robot

abstract: The invention provides a biped obstacle crossing detection robot for a ship cubicle, which comprises a trunk detection unit, a first walking unit, a second walking unit and a magnetic attraction foot unit, the trunk detection unit is located between the first walking unit and the second walking unit, the first walking unit and the second walking unit are of an asymmetric structure, and the magnetic attraction foot unit is located between the first walking unit and the second walking unit. The magnetic attraction foot unit is connected with the mounting end of the first walking unit and the mounting end of the second walking unit. The obstacle crossing detection method comprises the steps that according to an instruction sent by an upper computer, the rotating angles of the T-shaped joint modules in the first walking unit and the second walking unit and the power-on or power-off state of the power-on degaussing electromagnets of the magnetic attraction foot units are sequentially controlled, and moving or turning motion of the double-foot obstacle crossing detection robot is completed. Under the remote control of remote operation, obstacle crossing, detection and real-time monitoring tasks under the working conditions of multiple obstacles and narrow space are completed by utilizing the adsorption of the electrified degaussing electromagnets in the ship cubicles, so that the detection efficiency is improved.
source_title: Biped obstacle crossing detection robot for ship cubicles and obstacle crossing detection method

abstract: The present invention relates to a method for moving a bipedal exoskeleton (1) accommodating a human operator, the method comprising the implementation, by data processing means (11c) of the exoskeleton (1), of steps of: (a) obtaining a theoretical elementary trajectory of the exoskeleton (1); (b) executing a control loop defining the change in an actual position of the exoskeleton (1) so as to implement an actual elementary trajectory close to said theoretical elementary trajectory, comprising, in each iteration of the loop: - estimating a current state of the exoskeleton (1) as a function of said actual position; - determining a force torsor to be applied to the exoskeleton (1) in the next iteration of the loop to compensate for a deviation between said estimated current state of the exoskeleton (1) and an expected state of the exoskeleton (1) according to said theoretical elementary trajectory; the determination of the force torsor and/or the application thereof to the exoskeleton (1) taking into account a model of the flexibility of the exoskeleton (1) with respect to a rigid robot.
source_title: METHOD FOR MOVING AN EXOSKELETON

abstract: A servo system for controlling locomotion of a biped walking robot to follow up a target angle for each drive predetermined in series with respect to time. The control is stabilized by reducing the load on the on-board computer through the provision of an analog circuit for velocity control which has to be carried out in short control cycle and a digital circuit for positional control which can be carried out in relatively long control cycle. For reducing the control deviation to substantially zero, open-loop control is adopted for the motor angular velocity so as to prevent delay from arising in the joint angle control and position feedback control is conducted only in case where a deviation arises between the target joint angle and the actual joint angle owing to external disturbance or the like. <IMAGE>
source_title: System for controlling locomotion of legged walking robot

abstract: The invention discloses a walking control method and device of a biped robot, a storage medium and a terminal, and relates to the technical field of electronics, and mainly aims at solving the problems that in an existing dark or bright environment, when the biped walkable robot walks according to a black line road, recognition of a black line is easily influenced by exposed brightness, and the accuracy of a walking route is reduced. The method comprises the steps that a processor receives image signals and image information sent by a linear CCD image sensor and image shooting equipment respectively; exposure is determined according to the voltage value of the image signal, and a black line image is determined according to pixel information in the image information; the processor comparesthe exposure with a preset exposure, and compares the black line image with a preset black line image to obtain a first comparison result and a second comparison result; and a walking control instruction is generated according to the first comparison result and the second comparison result, and the walking control instruction is sent to a steering engine controller.
source_title: Walking control method and device of biped robot, storage medium and terminal

abstract: The invention discloses a two-section type foot end which comprises a foot part and a shoe part, the shoe part is made of integrally-formed flexible materials and covers the bottom face of the foot part in a shoe sole mode, a groove is formed in the middle area of the shoe part, the shoe part is divided into a front section and a rear section through the groove, and the front section and the rear section are made of elastic materials. The groove of the shoe part simulates an arch, and the front section and the rear section of the shoe part simulate a two-section type foot end structure of a front sole and a rear sole; the invention further discloses a biped robot using the two-section type foot end. Human gaits can be better simulated, meanwhile, the size and mass of the foot end can be reduced, due to the fact that no active or passive joint is additionally arranged on the foot end, the complexity of the foot end and the difficulty of robot control are greatly reduced, and cost is reduced.
source_title: Two-section type foot end and biped robot

abstract: The invention discloses a biped robot motion control method and system and electronic equipment. The method comprises the steps that a strategy network is obtained through auxiliary reward training; the strategy network generates a control signal according to the received control instruction and the current state of the biped robot; the control assembly controls the biped robot to move based on the control signal; wherein the auxiliary reward is used for feeding back training actions of the biped robot and optimizing a strategy network in training; the strategy network obtains a current state based on the control instruction; and the control assembly drives the joints of the biped robot to rotate so that the biped robot tends to the state required by the control instruction from the current state. According to the control method of the biped robot provided by the invention, the rotation of the joints of the biped robot is controlled through the strategy network which assists in reward pre-training, so that the motion fluency of the biped robot is improved, and the consistency of the trunk and the four limbs of the biped robot is improved.
source_title: Biped robot motion control method and system and electronic equipment

abstract: The z-component z(t) at a given time t is computed by using an auxiliary equation having the term about the z-component z(t) of the center of gravity of a biped walking robot in the equation of motion and a linear expression (a1t+a0) (S120 to S140). The x- and y-components x(t), y(t) of the center of gravity of the biped walking robot at the given time t are computed by using an equation of motion defined by substituting a linear expression for the term about the z-component z(t) of the center of gravity of the former equation of motion (S150, S160). The target angle ?<SUB>k</SUB>(t) of each joint k of the biped walking robot is computed by using the computed x-, y-, and z-components x(t), y(t), and z(t) of the center of gravity (S170). With this, a gait determined taking the motion of the z-component z(t) of the center of gravity into consideration can be generated, thus generating various gates.
source_title: GAIT GENERATING DEVICE, WALKING BODY DEVICE HAVING SAME, AND GAIT GENERATING METHOD

abstract: The invention provides a biped robot capable of realizing operation dimension conversion based on a single motor, the biped robot comprises a robot leg structure, a leg pulling assembly and a motor structure, the robot leg structure comprises a hip joint shaft, a thigh part, a knee joint shaft, a shank part, an ankle joint shaft and a foot part; the thigh part is connected with the shank part through a knee joint shaft; the shank part is connected with the foot part through an ankle joint shaft; the motor structure is arranged in the hip joint shaft; the leg pulling assembly comprises a first pulling piece and a second pulling piece; one end of the first pulling piece is connected to the motor structure, and the other end is connected to the knee joint shaft; one end of the second pulling piece is connected to the motor structure, and the other end is connected to the ankle joint shaft; and rotation of the motor structure enables common pulling action of the first pulling piece and the second pulling piece to drive the thigh part and the shank part to generate linear movement of the robot. The multiple joints of the whole leg can be driven only through one motor structure and the multiple stretching pieces, the complexity and weight of the mechanical structure are greatly reduced, meanwhile, energy consumption and heat loss are reduced, and the energy utilization efficiency is improved.
source_title: Biped robot capable of realizing operation dimension conversion based on single motor

abstract: The invention discloses a biped robot and a slope angle measurement method. The method comprises steps that original data corresponding to each scanning point collected by a radar device is acquired,n sets of quantized data are generated for each frame of the original data, each set of the quantized data includes values of a first variable, a second variable and a third variable, the value of thefirst variable is equal to the distance between the current scanning point and the radar device, the value of the second variable is equal to the inclination angle of the current scanning point relative to the radar device, and the value of the third variable is equal to the vertical distance between the current scanning point and the radar device; according to the n sets of quantified data, whenthe biped robot is determined to be in an uphill state, the n sets of quantized data are sorted, and largest m sets of data through sorting are extracted from the n sets of quantized data; the inclination angle of the slope where the biped robot is located is calculated according to the largest m sets of data. Compared with the prior art, the method is advantaged in that the road surface situation of the biped robot can be efficiently identified in real time.
source_title: Biped robot and slope angle measurement method

abstract: PURPOSE: A method for generating the movement of the center of waist and feet in a vertical, lateral, and front side of a robot to bipedal walk is provided to solve the short time in a bipedal support section by setting the movement around the waist and the feet in a horizontal direction with respect to the bipedal support section and to smoothly move even if the bipedal support section is increased. CONSTITUTION: A method for generating the movement of the center of waist and feet in a vertical, lateral, and front side of a robot to bipedal walk comprises a step of controlling the time in a bipedal support section by drawing the time of the bipedal support section of the bipedal robot and the trace of the waist and the feet using a central pattern generator(S10). [Reference numerals] (AA) Start; (BB) End; (S10) Draw the trace of the waist center and feet of a bipedal robot using a central pattern generator and control the time of a bipedal support section of the bipedal robot
source_title: STABLE BIPEDAL WALKING ROBOT METHOD FOR GENERATING VERTICAL DIRECTION AND THE CENTER OF THE WAIST AND FEET, THE MOVEMENT DIRECTION OF THE FRONT OF THE ROBOT

abstract: The invention provides a posture adjusting method, device and equipment of a biped robot and a storage medium, and relates to the field of biped robots. The method comprises the steps of obtaining the rolling angle and the rolling angle speed of the body of the biped robot; calculating a target rolling compensation angle of the sole of the biped robot according to the rolling angle and the rolling angle speed; calculating height compensation values of the two feet according to the target rolling compensation angle and the horizontal position distance between the two feet of the biped robot; and according to the height compensation value, adjusting the foot sole height of the two feet. Compared with the prior art, the problems that the mass center position of the robot cannot be effectively adjusted, and the posture control effect is poor are solved.
source_title: Posture adjusting method, device and equipment of biped robot, and storage medium

abstract: The invention discloses a novel walking control device and method for a biped robot. The device comprises a voice sensor module, an acceleration sensor module, a signal acquisition module, a core controller STM 32 module, a steering engine controller module and a liquid crystal display module. The method comprises the following steps: S1, the voice sensor module acquires and recognizes a voice signal and matches the voice signal with a previously-stored voice instruction and sends a specific instruction; S2, the core controller STM 32 module receives, converts and sends a corresponding instruction; S3, the steering engine controller module controls the robot to perform corresponding motions according to a received instruction; S4, the acceleration sensor module carries out an angle test ona sports robot; S5, the core controller STM 32 module collects, analyzes and processes angle testing data and sends the angle testing data to the liquid crystal display module and the steering enginecontroller module; S6, the steering engine controller module timely adjusts the running state of a steering engine according to a centric track so as to ensure that the steering engine runs smoothlyand monitors postures of the robot in a real-time manner.
source_title: Novel walking control device and method for biped robot

abstract: The invention relates to an actuator for the legs of a walking robot, mostly two-legged robots, comprising a mobile element and a motor located in said mobile element, wherein a base element of the leg is connected to the mobile element by a rotational articulation that is kinematically connected to the motor. The invention is characterized in that the kinematic circuit between the motor and the base element of the leg has a connecting rod-crank mechanism, the crank is kinematically connected to the motor and the connecting rod is connected to the base element of the leg by a rotational articulation. The length of the crank is smaller than the distance between the rotational articulations in the base element of the leg.
source_title: Actuator for the legs of a walking robot

abstract: A bipedal robot having a pair of legs with 6 degrees of freedom and a control method thereof which calculate a capture point by combining the position and velocity of the center of gravity (COG) and control the capture point during walking to stably control walking of the robot. A Finite State Machine (FSM) is configured to execute a motion similar to walking of a human, and thus the robot naturally walks without constraint that the knees be bent all the time, thereby being capable of walking with a large stride and effectively using energy required while walking.
source_title: Robot and control method thereof

abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of robots, and particularly relates to a mass center track generation method and device, a computer readable storage medium and a robot. The method comprises the following steps: determining a mass center actual pose, a left foot pose and a right foot pose of the robot; determining a first pose tracking vector of the robot according to the actual pose of the mass center and the pose of the left foot; determining a second pose tracking vector of the robot according to the actual pose of the mass center and the pose of the right foot; and according to the first pose tracking vector and the second pose tracking vector, controlling a mass center expected pose of the robot to alternately track the left foot pose and the right foot pose so as to generate a mass center expected trajectory of the robot. According to the method, the mass center track is generated according to the control idea that the mass center alternately tracks the two feet, and the stability of the robot is effectively improved.
source_title: Mass center track generation method and device, computer readable storage medium and robot

abstract: The invention discloses a driving system of an electro-hydraulic hybrid biped robot. Hydraulic driving is adopted for a large-load joint, the joint driving force and impact resistance are improved, motor driving is adopted for a small-load joint, and energy consumption of a driving system is reduced; the hydraulic power source comprises a high-pressure energy storage unit and a low-pressure energy storage unit, a hydraulic driving unit and a hydraulic pump are connected into the high-pressure energy storage unit or the low-pressure energy storage unit through a load pressure matching unit and an oil source pressure matching unit respectively, and energy consumption of the driving system is further reduced. Through parameter setting of the electro-hydraulic hybrid driving system, the energy consumption of the driving system is reduced, and the energy density of the driving system is improved, so that the purpose of efficient driving of the electro-hydraulic hybrid driving system is achieved.
source_title: Driving system of electro-hydraulic hybrid biped robot

abstract: A balance control method of a biped robot using state prediction of ZMP(Zero Moment Point) is provided to minimize uncertain modeling by compensating the predicted ZMP location with the angular velocity of the joint through inverse kinematics analysis of robot. A balance control method of a biped robot using state prediction of ZMP includes a process of simplifying state values of a kinetic model of the biped robot to a three-dimensional linear inverse pendulum model and adaptively compensating the state values of the kinetic model using a Kalman filter, and a process(1) of predicting the ZMP state for the next instruction cycle of the biped robot using the Kalman filter.
source_title: The balance control of biped robot using the predictive states of ZMP

abstract: The invention belongs to the relative technical field of machine body structure, and discloses a multi-DOF trunk mechanism for biped robots. The trunk mechanism includes an upper part, a pelvis, hip component and two hip pitch directional drive assemblies. The pelvis and the hip component are connected with the upper part. The two hip pitch directional drive assemblies are connected with the pelvis and the hip component. The upper part and the hip pitch directional drive assemblies are driven by an oil cylinder. The pelvis and the hip component are driven by a motor. The upper part achieves bending forward and backward, rolling left and right and the movement in vertical direction through three oil cylinders. The pelvis, the hip component are matched with the hip pitch directional drive assemblies to achieve the movement of the pelvis and the hip component of the robots in yaw direction, roll direction and pitch direction. The multi-DOF trunk mechanism for the biped robots improves therate of space utilization, and is simple in structure and good in sports performance.
source_title: Multi-DOF trunk mechanism for biped robots

abstract: The invention discloses a biped robot. The biped robot comprises a main body, a balance part, thighs, shanks and feet, wherein balance wheels are rotationally connected with the main body, first driving parts are used for driving thigh bodies to rotate relative to the main body, second driving parts are used for driving shank bodies to rotate relative to the thigh bodies, and third driving parts are used for driving rotating wheels to rotate; the auxiliary wheel can rotate along with rotation of the rotating wheel. According to the biped robot, motion modes of standing walking, kneeling posture walking and jumping can be compatible at the same time, all the motion modes can be rapidly switched, use flexibility is high, and the robot can keep good motion stability no matter what posture the robot moves.
source_title: Biped robot

abstract: The invention relates to a smart task type biped robot based on SLAM and machine vision and a control method thereof. The robot comprises steering engines, wheels, at least two sets of adjusting mechanisms connected with the steering engines and the wheels and driving parts connected with the wheels, wherein the adjusting mechanisms are symmetrically distributed on the two sides of the steering engines; each adjusting mechanism comprises a support rotationally connected with the wheels, a supporting arm, a first joint driver and a second joint driver, one end of the supporting arm is rotationally connected with the support through the first joint driver, and the other end of the supporting arm is rotationally connected with the steering engine through the second joint driver; when the first joint driver and the second joint driver rotate in the same direction, the steering engine and the wheels get close to each other or get away from each other. The robot has the effects of being convenient to move in complex terrains and improving the moving speed.
source_title: Smart task type biped robot based on SLAM and machine vision and control method thereof

abstract: A linking interlock mechanism in a biped robot is provided that prevents the reduction gears in the servo device from being damaged due to an external impulsive force. A servo horn is fit to the output shaft protruded from a servo device housing, which includes a motor, reduction gears, and the like. An interlock member for transmitting force externally is press fitted on the junction surface of the servo horn with the locking screw inserted via the washer. Salient portions are formed on the junction surface between the servo horn and the interlock member. The interlock member has depressed portions at the positions engaged with the salient portions. When a strong impulse force is externally added to the interlock member, the linking state between the interlock member and the servo horn isreleased instantaneously. This can prevent the reduction gears in the servo device from being damaged.
source_title: Linking mechanism of interlock members for robot and dual-feet robot

abstract: A biped ambulatory robot is provided having a structure in which the electrical storage device 19 is arranged to reduce the load on the joints (particularly the knee joints 14) of the leg members 2 of the robot and to enable easy maintenance of stability of the robot posture. The electrical storage device 19 which is a power supply for operation of the robot is installed on the electrical storage device unit 16 of the torso 1 of the robot, such that the center of gravity A of the electrical storage device exists on the forward side from the center of gravity B of the robot when in a vertically-erect posture and with the electrical storage device 19 removed. In a state in which the robot stands normally on the floor F with the knee joints 14 of the leg members 2 bent forward slightly, the center of gravity C of the entire robot including the electrical storage device 19 exists substantially directly above the knee joints 14 as seen from one side of the robot. <IMAGE>
source_title: Biped ambulatory robot

abstract: A floor shape estimation system for a legged mobile robot, in particular a biped walking robot, which estimates a floor shape (130), more specifically a foot-to-foot floor inclination difference based on at least a control error of the total floor reaction force's moment based on the estimated value and corrects a feet compensating angle (114b) based on the estimated value. Further, the system estimates a floor shape (130), more specifically a foot floor inclination difference based on at least a control error of the foot floor reaction force about a desired foot floor reaction force central point and corrects a foot compensating angle (114c) based on the estimated value. With this, it can accurately estimate the shape of a floor with which the robot is in contact. Further, if the floor shape is different from what has been supposed, it can produce the floor reaction force as desired by absorbing the influence of difference.
source_title: FLOOR SHAPE DEDUCING DEVICE FOR LEGGED MOBILE ROBOT

abstract: A two-legged walking robot (100) includes a pair of foot members (111) a calf member (113) provided above each foot member (111), a double-axis ankle joint (120) provided between the foot member (111) and the calf member (113) to allow the foot member (111) to rotate relative to the calf member (113) in forward and backward directions and in right and left directions. The robot also includes a femoral member (115) provided above each calf member (113), a single-axis knee joint (140) provided between the calf member (113) and the femoral member (115), a hip member (117) provided above the femoral member (115), and a double-axis hip joint (150) provided between the femoral member (115) and the hip member (117) to allow the femoral member (115) to rotate relative to the hip member (117) in the forward, backward, right, and left directions. Thus, preferred embodiments of the present invention provide a two-legged walking robot (100) to operate similar to a human ankle, knee and hip. <IMAGE>
source_title: Two-legged walking robot

abstract: The invention discloses a joint type biped high-voltage line inspection robot, relates to the technical field of robots, in particular to a high-voltage line inspection robot. The joint type biped high-voltage line inspection robot is high in maneuverability, stable, reliable, capable of crossing obstacles and changing lines, wide in application range and capable of walking along a high-voltage line and is provided with a climbing arm mechanism. The robot comprises a walking clamp A and a walking clamp B. The walking clamp A and the walking clamp B are respectively grabbed on the high-voltagecable, and can walk along the high-voltage cable. The walking clamp A and the walking clamp B are connected through a climbing mechanism, the climbing mechanism comprises a main machine frame, a heavyhammer and climbing arms symmetrically arranged on the two sides of the main machine frame, and the axis of the third rotating mechanism is parallel to the axis of the second connecting arm. The robot is ingenious in structure, high in maneuverability, wide in application range, stable and reliable.
source_title: Joint type biped high-voltage line inspection robot

abstract: The present invention relates to a bipedal or multi - legged robotic orthesis and exoskeleton system that can be used for apoplectic persons and robots. The system developed in the present invention is characterized in that, ' It has no outfit form, ' Has struts (12) possessing any type or several types of rotational and/or linear movement motors (3,11) and passing through any side of the right or left legs of the individuals, ' The person is suspended or connected to the struts (12) from any part of his/her body, ' Has motors (3,11) installed for moving the plates (6), functioning as feet, to a specific point and/or to cause the same to perform a specific action, and ' The feet of the suspended person are attached to the plates (6) of the system.
source_title: BIPEDAL OR MULTI-LEGGED ROBOTIC ORTHESIS AND EXOSKELETON SYSTEM

abstract: The invention discloses a bipedal robot capable of quickly walking. The bipedal robot comprises a counterweight assembly, a linear motor, a motor shaft, a motor seat, a telescopic fixing rod, left and right connecting rods, left and right thighs, left and right crura and left and right rotary air cylinders, wherein the linear motor is used for driving the left and right connecting rods to swing so as to drive the thighs hinged to the motor seat to swing back and forth; the left and right rotary air cylinders are used for driving the left and right crura to swing according to the relative position between the motor shaft and the motor seat to enable the supporting legs of the robot to be longer than the swinging legs of the robot so as to enable the robot to walk. Compared with the prior art, the bipedal robot has the advantages that the thighs are simultaneously driven to swing through the linear motor only, so that coordinated movement is facilitated; the control is convenient and the control precision is high; the structure is simple and compact and the stability is good; quick movement can be realized and the walking efficiency is relatively high; the robot is especially suitable for occasions with quickness and stability requirements.
source_title: Bipedal robot capable of quickly walking

abstract: The invention provides a bionic robot with two clamping feet, and relates to the technical field of service robots. The bionic robot with the two feet capable of being clamped comprises a vehicle body, a box body is arranged on the upper wall of the vehicle body, and the left side and the right side of the box body are each rotationally connected with a set of mechanical arms through a set of arm bases. According to the invention, by arranging the box body, objects can be carried and contained; the guide wheels can be matched with the driving wheels to support the vehicle body when the robot is static and travels on the flat ground, the connecting rod adjusting device can adjust the motion posture according to the road condition, and therefore the robot can be integrally kept in the horizontal motion state in cooperation with the guide wheels and the driving wheels, and bouncing action can be achieved to improve the obstacle crossing capacity. The first balance structure can keep the stability of the vehicle body when the clamping structure carries out the clamping action, a rubber sleeve provided with a magnetic powder bag and an electromagnetic coil is arranged in the third finger joint, when an object with an uneven surface or an irregular shape is clamped, the third finger joint can be made to be matched with the shape of the clamped object, and the clamping safety is greatly improved.
source_title: Bio-robot with two clamping feet

abstract: Provided is an automatically controlled robot walking on two feet. The middle of a first connecting rod is connected with one end of a first support rod, one end of the first connecting rod is connected to a first sliding block, the other end of the first connecting rod is connected with one end of a second connecting rod, the other end of the second connecting rod is connected to the middle of a third connecting rod, one end of the third connecting rod is connected with one end of a second support rod, the other end of the third connecting rod is connected with one end of a fourth connecting rod, the other end of the fourth connecting rod is connected to a sole part, the middle of a seventh connecting rod is connected with one end of a third support rod, one end of the seventh connecting rod is connected to a second sliding block, the other end of the seventh connecting rod is connected with one end of an eighth connecting rod, and the other end of the eighth connecting rod is connected to the middle of the fourth connecting rod. According to the automatically controlled robot walking on the two feet, only one servo motor is adopted to serve as a power source, motion is divided into two ways through a chain-drive mechanism to drive reciprocating motion of a thigh and reciprocating motion of a shank respectively, the structure is simple, the layout is reasonable, the range of motion of the robot legs is wide, the bearing capacity of the robot legs is high, and assembling is convenient.
source_title: Automatically controlled robot walking on two feet

abstract: The invention discloses a hand-foot switching multi-mode quadruped specialized robot. The hand-foot switching multi-mode quadruped specialized robot is composed of a robot body, a visual system, a positioning module, a control module, a driving module, a power module and a storage module. The robot body comprises a robot body, a front foot of the robot, a rear foot of the robot, an external metal protection frame, a camera and a microphone; and the control module comprises a quadruped control module and a biped control module. The advantages and disadvantages of the quadruped robot and the biped robot are comprehensively considered, so that the hand-foot switching multi-mode quadruped specialized robot has the advantages of high moving efficiency and high terrain adaptability of the quadruped robot, and further has the advantages that the biped robot is provided with a mechanical arm and a manipulator and can perform basic flexible operation and complete complex moving actions. A machine body is divided into two sections, each of two sections is connected to the other section by a spherical hinge, and the hinge is driven by three two-degree-of-freedom motors.
source_title: Hand-foot switching multi-mode quadruped specialized robot

abstract: The invention discloses a biped bionic mechanical chicken system, and relates to the technical field of biped robot equipment.The biped bionic mechanical chicken system comprises an aluminum alloy support, a chicken head swing part is installed at the top of the aluminum alloy support, and a chicken leg movement device is installed at the position, located on one side of the chicken head swing part, of the top of the aluminum alloy support; the double-foot bionic mechanical chicken has the advantages that the crank rocker mechanism for driving the head of the double-foot bionic mechanical chicken to swing and the connecting rod mechanism for driving the legs to move are designed, the two mechanisms are linked through belt transmission, the head of the double-foot bionic mechanical chicken swings along with walking, the bionic effect is better displayed, meanwhile, the number of driving elements is reduced, and the driving efficiency is improved. The system structure is simplified, the system reliability is improved and the cost is reduced; a steering device, an aluminum alloy structure and a simple control system of the biped bionic mechanical chicken are designed, the cost of the bionic mechanical chicken is reduced, the working reliability and durability are improved, and when the mechanical chicken breaks down, maintenance is easy, and the cost is low.
source_title: Biped bionic mechanical chicken system

abstract: The invention discloses a biped wall-climbing robot mechanism, which belongs to the technical field of high-altitude climbing equipment. The biped wall-climbing robot mechanism comprises two foot structures which are symmetrically arranged left and right, and each foot structure comprises a foot adsorption device, a first motion control steering engine, a second motion control steering engine anda third motion control steering engine which are sequentially arranged from bottom to top; each foot adsorption device is connected with one end of a first motion control steering engine through a steering engine foot connecting block, the other end of the first motion control steering engine is connected with one end of a second motion steering engine, and the other end of the second motion steering engine is connected with one end of a third motion control steering engine, the two third motion control steering engines which are symmetrical left and right are connected through a top fixed connection block; and a control element is arranged on the top fixed block. According to the wall-climbing robot structure, the wall surface obstacle-crossing capacity of the wall-climbing robot can be improved, the wall-climbing robot structure is suitable for a working surface with higher fluctuation, conversion from the ground to the wall surface and from the wall surface to a ceiling can be completed more easily, the size of the robot is reduced to a certain extent, and the wall-climbing robot structure is suitable for narrower pipeline work.
source_title: Biped wall-climbing robot mechanism

abstract: The invention relates to a mechanical leg and a biped robot. The mechanical leg comprises a hip joint part, a thigh part, a knee joint part, a shank part and a foot part, the thigh part comprises a thigh front part and a thigh rear part, the upper end is rotationally connected to the hip joint part, and the lower end is rotationally connected to the knee joint part; the shank part comprises a shank front part and a shank rear part, the upper end is rotationally connected to the knee joint part, and the lower end is rotationally connected to the foot part; wherein the hip joint part, the thigh front part, the knee joint part and the thigh rear part form a first parallel connecting rod mechanism, the knee joint part, the shank front part, the foot part and the shank rear part form a second parallel four connecting rod mechanism, and the first parallel four connecting rod mechanism and the second parallel four connecting rod mechanism are matched to enable the foot part to be in a horizontal state when the foot part stands upright and moves. The control difficulty of the mechanical legs is reduced, and low-power-consumption gait walking of the robot is achieved; freedom degrees do not need to be set for the feet, the shank parts can be made thinner, and the weight, the cost and the control difficulty of the mechanical legs are reduced.
source_title: Mechanical leg and biped robot

abstract: Disclosed is a four-foot robot static gait planning method based on terrain fuzzy self-adaption. The four-foot robot static gait planning method based on terrain fuzzy self-adaption comprises the following steps of (1) calculating a trunk pitching angle according to foot falling position information of a robot; (2) planning a trunk movement track, and ensuring the stability of the robot in a nextstepping stage; (3) estimating the complexity of walking terrain by using the time of ground touching of two feet of the robot, and automatically adjusting parameters of truck moving track planning onthe basis of a fuzzy algorithm; and (4) completing a complete gait cycle and repeating the whole process. By means of the method, the pitching angle of a trunk can be automatically adjusted accordingto the terrain fluctuation in the walking process of the fur-foot robot, and the height and the terrain adaptability of the four-foot robot swinging feet across an obstacle are effectively increasedand improved respectively; the situation that the robot loses stability due to the fact that the speed or the acceleration is suddenly changed is effectively avoided; the self-adaption of the four-foot robot to the terrain is realized, and the terrain adaptability of the four-foot robot is effectively improved.
source_title: Four-foot robot static gait planning method based on terrain fuzzy self-adaption

abstract: The invention discloses a wheel-foot composite walking mechanism which comprises a hip joint rotating shaft, a knee joint motor fixing plate, a knee joint motor, a knee joint rotating shaft, an anklejoint motor, a shank structural part, an ankle joint rotating shaft, a foot structural part, a driving wheel and a driven wheel. The driving wheel and the driven wheel are arranged on the foot structural part, so that when the robot walks on the flat ground, all the motors of the legs enable the joints to be in a locked state through the locking elements; and at the moment, walking of the robot can be controlled as long as the driving wheel is independently controlled; the advantages of the wheeled robot can be played, and the walking speed is increased; other joints do not need to participatein movement, and the motors can be completely in a power-off state, so that energy is saved, and the working time is prolonged; and when the robot encounters an obstacle and needs to cross the obstacle, the driving wheel and the driven wheel on the foot structural part are locked, motors of the legs act in a coordinated mode, and the advantage that a conventional biped robot is good in environmental adaptability is brought into play.
source_title: Wheel-foot composite walking mechanism

abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of robots, and particularly relates to a robot state estimation method and device, a computer readable storage medium and a robot. The method comprises the steps: acquiring left foot stress information and right foot stress information of the robot; according to the left foot stress information and the right foot stress information, calculating a double-foot zero moment point of the robot under a world coordinate system; and calculating the mass center position of the robot based on a preset linear inverted pendulum model. According to the method, the brand new linear inverted pendulum model is pre-constructed, the biped zero moment point of the robot is taken as the supporting point of the model, the influence of the position change of the biped zero moment point on the position of the center of mass is fully considered, and a more accurate estimation result can be obtained based on the model.
source_title: Robot state estimation method and device, readable storage medium and robot

abstract: The invention relates to a quadruped robot walking and diagonal gait motion control method, which comprises the following steps of: 1, simulating the motion of a quadruped robot by using a low-dimensional point mass model, and establishing a discrete state equation of a previewing time domain motion process by using a discretization method; 2, processing walking and small running gaits of the quadruped robot through a linear constraint domain, and determining an optimization interval; 3, establishing a performance index evaluation function of the robot gait motion control model in the previewing time domain, and solving an expected landing point and a mass center position of the robot; 4, according to the expected landing point and the mass center position of the robot, motion control over the quadruped robot is achieved. According to the motion control method provided by the invention, a pre-observation time domain discrete state equation is established by using a discretization method; a quadruped robot gait mode and a biped robot gait mode are mapped, and a linear constraint domain is introduced to process robot motion; the problem of motion control of walking and small running gaits of the robot is solved, and high robustness is achieved.
source_title: Quadruped robot walking and diagonal gait motion control method

abstract: The invention provides a balance control method for dynamic walking of a biped robot. The method comprises the following steps: firstly planning an ideal gait, further calculating the landing time according to the current state of the robot, determining a priority plane, calculating the position of a landing point based on the priority plane, and achieving the planning control of the landing point under the condition of external disturbance. The method does not need to measure the size and direction of the disturbance, achieves the balance control of the robot only by observing the state change of the robot after the disturbance is applied, and can be used for the situation that the biped robot is disturbed in all directions in the omni-directional walking process.
source_title: Balance control method for dynamic walking of biped robot

abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of robots, and particularly relates to a robot gait planning method and device, a computer readable storage medium and a robot. The method comprises the following steps: determining a foot attitude angle of the biped robot; calculating an ankle-foot position vector according to the foot attitude angle, wherein the ankle-foot position vector is a position vector from an ankle to a sole supporting point of the biped robot; calculating the ankle position change amount of the biped robot according to the foot attitude angle and the ankle-foot position vector; compensating the ankle position of the biped robot according to the ankle position variation, and obtaining the compensated ankle position. According to the embodiment of the invention, the leg length is increased by virtue of the change of the foot attitude angle, namely, the turning of the foot sole, so that the movement efficiency of the biped robot under the conditions of complex movement, rapid walking and the like is improved, meanwhile, the problem of shaking of the swinging leg caused by the violent change of the ankle position in the movement process is solved, and the movement balance of the biped robot is improved.
source_title: Robot gait planning method and device, readable storage medium and robot

abstract: The invention relates to a gear transmission halving upper body energy-saving passive moving device. The gear transmission halving upper body energy-saving passive walking device comprises an upper body, legs, a driving unit and a data acquisition unit and further comprises a hip, knees, a main control unit and a spring unit. The driving unit comprises a battery, a direct current motor and a servo motor. The upper body is directly connected to the hip of the robot. The hip is of a symmetrical structure and in connection with the upper body and both sides of the hip are connected to the legs respectively. The hip comprises partial leg connecting shafts, bearings, an absolute encoder connecting shaft and bevel gears. The bevel gears of the hip are of a triple-bevel-gear symmetrical structure and the two bevel gears in bilateral symmetry are connected to the legs through the partial leg connecting shafts respectively. The partial leg connecting shafts are connected to the bearings. The third bevel gear is directly connected to a transmission shaft of the motor. The gear transmission halving upper body energy-saving passive walking device is a bipedal walking device which is simple and compact in structure, ingenious in design and energy-saving.
source_title: Gear transmission halving upper body energy-saving passive walking device and control method thereof

abstract: A dynamic footprint set generation method, a biped robot using die same, and a computer readable storage medium are provided.
