The method includes: obtaining preset footprint calculation parameters; calculating a landing point position based on the preset footprint calculation parameters; determining a landing point range based on a landing point position, and performing a collision detection on the landing point range; recording the corresponding landing point position in a footprint set in response to the detection result representing there being no collision; obtaining a preset adjustment amplitude to update a preset displacement angle after the recording is completed; and returning to the calculating the landing point position until the footprint set is generated. By continuously adjusting the preset displacement angle, each landing point position is calculated accordingly, and the valid landing point positions are recorded in the footprint set, which provides more feasible landing points for navigation planning.
source_title: Dynamic footprint set generation method, biped robot using the same, and computer readable storage medium

abstract: A legged walking robot such as a two-legged walking robot, for example, has an articulated structure with at least two degrees of freedom, one of which is a degree of freedom for angularly moving a leg in a pitch direction about a first axis (12) of a hip joint assembly, comprising an electric motor (74) for angularly moving the leg in the pitch direction. The electric motor has an output shaft which is axially aligned with the first axis (12) about which the leg is angularly movable in the pitch direction. The articulated structure also has a speed reducer (72) having an input shaft which is coaxial with the output shaft of the electric motor. The other degree of freedom is a degree of freedom for angularly moving the leg in a roll direction normal to the pitch direction. The articulated structure also includes a second electric motor (52) for angularly moving the leg in the roll direction and a second speed reducer (56) having an output shaft which is coaxial with a second axis about which the leg is angularly movable in the roll direction. <IMAGE>
source_title: Articulated structure for legged walking robot

abstract: The invention discloses a biped robot space domain gait planning and control method which comprises the following steps: setting the horizontal distance of a biped robot hip joint relative to a supporting leg ankle joint as a phase variable delta, and designing and optimizing a swing leg joint reference angle track based on the phase variable according to a current state, a reference step length and a reference speed; swinging leg gait planning in a space domain is completed; a second-order inverted pendulum model is established, and a support leg hip joint reference moment for speed control is optimized through nonlinear model prediction control; after the swing leg joint reference angle track and the supporting leg hip joint reference torque are obtained, the joint torque is optimized in a multi-target task through whole-body dynamics Quadratic Programming control, and then gait walking of the robot is controlled. According to the method, the motion of swinging the ankle joint is separated from the time, so that the ankle joint only depends on the own state, and the robustness is enhanced.
source_title: Biped robot space domain gait planning and control method

abstract: The invention relates to a method and a system for assisting a biped robot to walk by using a vacuum adsorption device. The method and the system aim at providing an effective mode, so that the biped robot walks more stably and efficiently in an uneven environment or an environment with a low-friction surface. By means of the vacuum adsorption device, the adhesive force between the biped robot and the ground can be increased in the walking process, and therefore the stability is enhanced, and the slipping risk is reduced.
source_title: Method and system for assisting walking of biped robot by using vacuum adsorption device

abstract: The invention discloses a biped mobile robot system with literacy capability. The biped mobile robot system comprises a robot body, the robot body is provided with a processor module, a steering engine control module and a text processing module. The steering engine control module and the text processing module are in communication connection with the processor module. The text processing module comprises an image acquisition unit, an image text recognition unit and a text database; the image acquisition unit acquires a natural scene and sends a scene image to the image text recognition unit;the image text recognition unit is used for recognizing characters in the image through a character database and transmitting character data information to the processor module; the processor module sends a control signal to the steering engine control module. The method has the advantages that the natural scene text can be subjected to literacy positioning, meanwhile, the control algorithm and gait planning of the system are simplified, occupied resources and weight are reduced, actions are more flexible and stable, and the method is more suitable for the field of commercial services.
source_title: Biped mobile robot system with literacy capability

abstract: A robot design and control system including a procedural animation engine and a graphical animation editor that enable animators to author stylized walking gaits achievable by physical robotic characters, including bipedal robots of varying design. The animation engine generates dynamically feasible reference trajectories for omnidirectional walking given a desired walking velocity that may be input from a joystick or an artificial intelligence (AI) planner. This allows a legged robot to walk along an arbitrary path while expressing a custom animation “style,” e.g., a happy walk, a sneaky walk, or other manner of walking. The stylized walking motion or gait is generalized by the animation engine from a small number of animation samples that are defined at key walking velocities and tracked using a whole-body controller. The set of samples that are used as input to define a walking style is authored by an animator using the animation editor.
source_title: Procedural animation engine and editor for sample-based design of stylized walking gaits for bipedal robots

abstract: In a walking robot, particularly a biped walking robot (1), having a body (3) and two articulated legs (2) each connected to the body and each having a foot (22) at its free end such that the robot is controlled to walk by landing a heel (68) of the foot first on a floor. The heel of the foot has projections and packing or filler (76a, 80, 86, 88, 90) charged in gaps between the projections. The projections are constituted to have a relatively higher rigidity against forces acting in the vertical direction and a relatively lower rigidity, which is lower than the first rigidity, against forces acting in other directions, when the heel (68) is landed, thereby enabling to achieve an optimum balance between absorption/mitigation of shock at footfall and attitude stabilization after footfall. <IMAGE>
source_title: Legged walking robot

abstract: Provided is a method for determining the timing with which a biped walking robot lands a foot. In this method, first, a ZMP equation representative of the track of a center of gravity is solved using a given landing timing, the equation including a first single-foot ground contact period during which the robot stands only on a first foot and a second single-foot ground contact period during which the robot stands only on a second foot subsequently after the first single-foot ground contact period. A second-foot ZMP position is calculated which is indicative of a ZMP position during the second single-foot ground contact period. If the resulting second-foot ZMP position is out of a second-foot ZMP tolerable region which is defined corresponding to a second-foot landing allowable region, the landing timing is modified so that the second-foot ZMP position is within the second-foot ZMP tolerable region.
source_title: BIPED WALKING ROBOT AND METHOD OF DETERMINING THE FOOT-LANDING TIMING FOR THE BIPED WALKING ROBOT

abstract: The invention discloses a data processing method and device for assisting medicine taking. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring basic medicine taking information of a target user; determining a target medicine taking time range of the target user according to the basic medicine taking information; when the current system time is the earliest medicine taking time point in the target medicine taking time range, a target posture is determined; determining a current state of the target user through the target posture, wherein the current state comprises a sleep state and a non-sleep state; when it is detected that the current state is the sleep state, a first medicine taking reminding strategy is executed. After the target medicine taking time range of the target user is determined, when the current system time falls into the target medicine taking time range, the biped robot determines the current state of the target user according to the target posture, and the corresponding first medicine taking reminding strategy is executed when the target user is in the sleep state. The corresponding medicine taking reminding strategy can be executed according to the state of the user when the medicine taking time arrives, and the intelligent and humanized degree of auxiliary medicine taking is improved.
source_title: Data processing method and device for assisting medicine taking

abstract: The invention relates to a biped robot nonlinear model predictive controller FPGA heterogeneous acceleration method, which comprises the following steps: establishing an NMPC model according to a biped robot dynamic model, iteratively solving a quadratic programming form of the NMPC model, and completing a single iteration process: solving by a primitive-dual interior point method and solving a symmetric linear equation set by a minres algorithm; the process of solving the solution of the linear equation set constructed by using the KKT condition based on the quadratic programming form through the primitive-dual interior point method is configured to be executed by a CPU; the process of solving the symmetric linear equation set by the minres algorithm is configured to be executed by the FPGA. According to different calculation characteristics of a solution operator in a biped robot NMPC model, a logic reusable minres algorithm in the solution process is deployed to an FPGA calculation platform, and nonlinear operation is deployed to a CPU for implementation, so that the calculation power characteristic of a heterogeneous chip is fully utilized. According to the method, robot dynamics modeling, an efficient optimization solution algorithm and appropriate computing power resource allocation are considered, and the acceleration effect and verification of the algorithm can be ensured.
source_title: Biped robot nonlinear model predictive controller FPGA heterogeneous acceleration method

abstract: A method for modeling a robot simplified for stable walking control of a bipedal robot provides a robot model that is simplified as a virtual pendulum model including a virtual body, two virtual legs connected to the body at a virtual pivot point (VPP) that is set at a position higher than the center of mass (CoM) of the body, and virtual feet connected to the two legs, respectively, to step on the ground. A ground reaction force, which acts on the two legs, acts towards the VPP, thereby providing a restoring moment with respect to the CoM such that stabilization of the posture of the body naturally occurs.
source_title: METHOD FOR MODELING ROBOT SIMPLIFIED FOR STABLE WALKING CONTROL OF BIPEDAL ROBOT

abstract: The invention relates to the field of robots, and discloses a biped robot ankle joint mechanism based on body intelligence, which comprises a base, a similar sliding film, a semicircular silica gel joint head and a base, the sensor comprises an excitation sensor and a suppression sensor, the excitation sensor and the suppression sensor work mutually, and finally, on the premise that the ankle joint of the robot does not depend on a controller, the robot interacts with the pneumatic artificial muscle through the body, the ground and the sensing-driving integrated system, and finally the ankle joint is autonomously driven. Finally, efficient interactive perception of the external environment and the state of the robot is achieved, the adaptability of the robot in the complex environment is improved, and dependence on electric appliance sensing elements is reduced.
source_title: Biped robot ankle joint mechanism based on body intelligence

abstract: The invention discloses a movement control method, a foot type robot and a computer readable storage medium. The movement control method is used for the foot type robot, the foot type robot is provided with at least two feet, and the movement control method comprises the steps that expected foot falling areas of swing feet are updated, and each expected foot falling area comprises at least two optional foot falling points; if the number of the swinging feet is one, an expected landing point is screened out from the at least two selectable landing points according to a screening condition; if the number of the swing feet is larger than or equal to two, the selectable landing points corresponding to the swing feet are combined to form a plurality of selectable landing point combinations, and the selectable landing point combinations comprise one selectable landing point of each swing foot, an expected landing point combination is screened out from the selectable landing point combinations according to screening conditions. According to the movement control method, the stepping movement effect of the foot type robot can be achieved, and the stability of the robot body during movement is improved.
source_title: Movement control method, legged robot and computer readable storage medium

abstract: The invention discloses a shock-absorbing and energy-storing foot structure and a biped robot, the foot structure comprises a shank, a support lug, a connecting rod, a universal joint, a foot supporting component and a shock-absorbing and energy-storing elastic component, the foot supporting component comprises an upper connecting plate, a lower connecting plate and an inclined connecting plate, the first connecting part of the shank is mounted in the first connecting hole of the universal joint; the first mounting part of the support lug is hinged to the support lug mounting part of the shank; a pin component at one end of the connecting rod is mounted on the second connecting part of the support lug, and the other end is mounted on the second mounting part of the upper connecting plate; the third mounting part of the upper connecting plate is mounted in the first connecting hole through a thread; and the damping and energy storage elastic components are respectively arranged on the inclined connecting plate and the lower connecting plate. The damping and energy storage elastic components are additionally arranged on the sole and the toes, so that the damping and energy storage capacity of the foot structure is achieved, large rigid impact between the foot structure and the ground in the movement process is avoided, and the movement performance of the biped robot is improved.
source_title: Shock absorption and energy storage foot structure and biped robot

abstract: The invention relates to a biped robot with multiple motion modes, which belongs to the technical field of robots, and is characterized by comprising a four-curved-bar mechanical leg mechanism, a machine body box body, a leg box body, a coaxial transmission system, a hinge gear transmission system and a power motor, the coaxial transmission system is output by a power motor and decelerated to an inner sleeve shaft and an outer sleeve shaft through a synchronous belt, and two curved bars of the four-curved-bar mechanical leg are respectively connected with the inner sleeve shaft and the outer sleeve shaft in the coaxial transmission system and are fixed on a leg box body; a lower plate of the machine body is connected with a lower plate of the leg box body through a hinge gear transmission system, and output of a power motor at the machine body is reduced to a hinge sleeve at the leg box body through transmission of a pair of gears; the number of the power motors is six. The leg motor is controlled to drive the four-crank-lever mechanical leg mechanism to generate structural deformation, and the motor at the machine body is controlled to realize rotation and swing of the leg box body. By coordinating and controlling the six motors, the biped robot can achieve wheel, foot and claw type movement and conversion and left-right walking movement.
source_title: Biped robot with multiple motion modes

abstract: The invention discloses a biped robot omni-directional walking centroid trajectory planning method based on double-layer model predictive control, and the method comprises the steps: obtaining a sparse centroid motion trajectory and a ZMP trajectory through an upper MPC under the condition of meeting ZMP stability constraint and centroid motion feasible region constraint; the lower-layer MPC takes tracking of the upper-layer sparse trajectory as a target to obtain a dense centroid position motion trajectory; and after the dense trajectory is judged to be non-divergent by the centroid trajectory detector, the centroid movement position at the current moment is output for the robot to use. According to the method, a variable-period double-layer model prediction control structure is adopted, the accuracy and real-time performance of track generation are considered, and robot hardware can be prevented from being damaged by divergent tracks through centroid track detection.
source_title: Biped robot omni-directional walking centroid trajectory planning method based on double-layer model predictive control

abstract: The invention provides a robot footprint generation method and device, a robot and a medium, and relates to the technical field of data processing. The method comprises the following steps of: performing softening processing on a preset walking path to obtain a target walking path; processing the target walking path according to the biped spacing of a biped robot to obtain a biped walking path ofthe biped robot; and obtaining a footprint sequence of the biped robot according to a preset stepping distance and the biped walking path. According to the method, the target walking path after softening processing is obtained, the break angle in the target walking path is subjected to smoothing processing, then the biped walking path obtained based on the target walking path is softer and smoother, the footprint sequence obtained based on the biped walking path is softer and smoother, steering is more natural, the biped robot is controlled to walk based on the footprint sequence, so that thebiped robot can walk more smoothly.
source_title: Robot footprint generation method and device, robot and medium

abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of robots, in particular to a biped robot. The biped robot comprises a body, a walking function module, an infrared obstacle avoiding module, a dance function module, a communication module and a controller. Due to the walking function module, the robot can walk; due to the infrared obstacle avoiding module, the robot can stop moving forwards when encountering obstacles; and due to the dance function module, the robot can dance automatically. The biped robot is used for carrying out programming teaching activities, the difficulty of children on programming cognition can be lowered, the fear of children on programming is reduced, and children are attracted in studying programming. The biped robot is a platform for bringing children into contact with programming on education, and due to the platform, the science and technology course of children becomes more vivid and more interesting.
source_title: Biped robot

abstract: The present invention relates to a series elastic actuator device, which comprises: a housing unit; a first generation unit which is built in the housing unit and generates power when electric power is applied; a first transmission unit for transmitting the power of the first generation unit; a first driving unit connected to the first transmission unit and driven; a second generation unit built into the housing unit and generating power when electric power is applied; a second transmission unit which transmits the power of the second generation unit and passes through the first transmission unit; and a second driving unit connected to the second transmission unit and driven. The series elastic actuator device may provide power to the joint of the biped or quadruped robot and reduce the amount of impact from the outside.
source_title: SERIES ELASTIC ACTUATOR DEVICE

abstract: The invention aims to provide a wall-climbing robot based on electrostatic adsorption, which comprises a middle electrostatic chuck and electrostatic chucks, namely a left electrostatic chuck and a right electrostatic chuck, positioned on two sides of the middle electrostatic chuck, the motion mode of the gait of the two feet is achieved through transmission of the motor and the worm and gear, meanwhile, the steering engine is used as a switch to control adsorption and desorption of the electrostatic chuck, cooperative control over the driving motor, the control steering engine and the boosting module is achieved through an integrated circuit board, and seamless switching of adsorption force of the two feet can be achieved.
source_title: Wall climbing robot based on electrostatic adsorption

abstract: The invention provides an intelligent biped walking robot. The intelligent biped walking robot comprises a curved-surface display system, a vision sensing system, an infrared induction system, a driving mechanism and a gyroscope stabilimeter mechanism. An upper joint on each thigh is hinged to a body through a steering engine, and a lower joint of each thigh is hinged to an upper joint of a shank through a steering engine, a lower joint of each shank is hinged to a foot upper cover through a steering engine. A steering engine is mounted on the neck of the robot and can control the robot to node for communication. The vision sensing system which can achieve face recognition and has a memory function is mounted in eyes on a head. The steering engines can control motions of leg joints according to programs set in the control system, so that walking of the robot is achieved. The curved-surface display system comprises a curved-surface display screen and an audio playing system. The infrared induction system which can achieve imaging recognition is mounted above the curved-surface display screen. The eyes are connected with the corresponding steering engine and can be driven by the steering engine to rotate for eye contact.
source_title: Intelligent biped walking robot

abstract: The invention provides a biped robot landing position control system and a biped robot landing position control method. The biped robot landing position control method comprises the following steps of: 1) planning a feasible collision-free path by using a path planning algorithm; 2) determining foot-landing regions of swinging foots according to a step length constraint, motion ability, foot sizeand center offset of a biped robot; 3) and determining a specific foot position of the robot through fuzzy processing. According to the biped robot landing position control system and the biped robotlanding position control method, when a specific walking action is executed after path planning of the biped robot is finished, proper foot landing positions on the two sides of the path are selected;and the biped robot landing position control system and the biped robot landing position control method have the advantages of being simple, easy to implement, small in calculation load, high in speed, capable of exerting the extreme movement capacity of different biped robots and enabling the biped robots to move more flexibly and the like.
source_title: Biped robot foot landing position control system and method

abstract: The two legged robot has a stabilising actuator in the form of a gyroscopic rotor [1] with a coupled motor [2] that is controlled [3] based upon rotational speed [5] and robot position [4]. The actuator speed is controlled such that its inertial force varies dependent on position to provide a stabilising action.
source_title: Stability control of a two legged robot is provided by controlling the speed of the inertial rotor of a gyroscopic actuator

abstract: The invention discloses a wheel type biped robot and a control method thereof, belongs to the technical field of biped wheel-leg robots, and solves the technical problems that in the prior art, the biped wheel-leg robot is short in continuous working time, single in function, low in moving efficiency and incapable of adapting to complex environments. The robot comprises a trunk part, a walking part and a working part, wherein the walking part and the working part are connected with the trunk part; the trunk part comprises a pair of middle plates, and a plurality of supporting rods are arranged between the middle plates; a battery assembly, a driver assembly, an encoder assembly and a main control assembly are arranged between the pair of middle plates. The walking part comprises a driving leg, a driven leg and a shank; the working part comprises a base, the base is arranged on the lower portion of the trunk part, and a caliper assembly is arranged on the base. According to the wheeled biped robot and the control method thereof, the wheeled biped robot can be better used for work such as scientific research, medical instruments, logistics transportation, environment exploration and disaster area search and rescue, stability is good, and adaptability is high.
source_title: Wheeled biped robot and control method thereof

abstract: The invention provides a three-degree-of-freedom biped robot, and relates to the technical field of robots. The three-degree-of-freedom biped robot comprises a robot body, movement mechanisms and a balance mechanism, the movement mechanisms are arranged on the two sides of the robot body correspondingly and rotationally connected with the robot body, the movement mechanisms and the robot body form a four-connecting-rod structure, and the balance mechanism is arranged on the robot body and suitable for applying balance torque to the robot body. According to the three-degree-of-freedom biped robot provided by the invention, the overall structure is optimized, the control difficulty can be reduced, the motion precision can be improved, and the cost can be reduced.
source_title: Three-degree-of-freedom biped robot

abstract: A system for controlling locomotion of a legged such as a biped walking robot having a body and two legs connected to the body. Positional walking data are preestablished in advance with respect to the robot's center of gravity, foot position and the like. First, a difference between the robot's center of gravity at time t (current time) and at time t+delta t (next time) defined in the walking data is calculated. From the difference, then, a positional correction amount of the robot's hip position, which is decisive for determining the robot's attitude, at the time t+delta t is determined, and the robot's attitude at the time is determined from the corrected hip position and the foot position or the like preestablished in the walking data. And based on the determined attitude at the time, target joints angles of the robot is calculated and the joints are driven to the determined target angles. Since the walking data are preestablished in terms of the positional information, locomotion can be modified as required during walking. In another embodiment, forces acting on the robot legs are detected to estimate the robot's center of gravity at the current time (time t). The estimated value is used to determine the difference to be used to determine hip position correction amount which is in turn used in the robot's attitude.
source_title: Locomotion control system for legged mobiled robot

abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of robots, and particularly relates to a gait planning method and device for dynamic obstacle avoidance, a computer readable storage medium and a robot. According to the method, obstacle detection is carried out on an advancing path of the robot; if the obstacle is detected, the envelope size of the obstacle is measured through vision; if the envelope size of the obstacle is smaller than a preset size threshold value, gait planning of the robot is carried out according to a preset stepping gait; and if the envelope size of the obstacle is larger than or equal to the size threshold value, gait planning of the robot is carried out according to a preset winding gait. Through the method, the size of the obstacle is detected based on vision, the entering gait algorithm is judged according to the size of the obstacle, the stepping gait and the winding gait are planned, the adaptive capacity of the biped robot to the complex obstacle environment is improved, and meanwhile the movement efficiency of the robot is improved.
source_title: Gait planning method and device for dynamic obstacle avoidance, readable storage medium and robot

abstract: A control device for a bipedal mobile robot generates a desired motion of a bipedal mobile robot. When causing the robot to perform a one-leg hopping operation, a desired motion of the robot is generated such that the proximal end portion of a free leg of the robot is positioned at a relatively higher level than the proximal end portion of a supporting leg thereof in the state wherein the supporting leg has landed on a floor after leaving from the floor and such that the horizontal distance between the total center-of-gravity point of the robot and the proximal end portion of the supporting leg in the aforesaid state is shorter than the horizontal distance therebetween in a state wherein the robot is standing in an upright posture.
source_title: Control device and gait generating device for bipedal mobile robot

abstract: The invention discloses a biped robot with bionic tension-compression joints. The biped robot with the bionic tension-compression joints comprises a frame, thighs, shanks, sole plates and toes which are connected by using bionic tension-compression hip joints, bionic tension-compression knee joints, bionic tension-compression ankle joints and bionic tension-compression metatarsophalangeal joints.On each leg, the joint stability and energy transmission are mutually maintained by using a passive soft member and an active soft member, wherein the active soft member is mainly used as a driver toprovide power to the whole robot so as to realize motions of the thighs, the shanks, the sole plates and the toes. By using a mode of using the bionic tension-compression joints to simulate driving and energy flowing of a human skeletal muscle system, the biped robot with the bionic tension-compression joints has the advantages of higher flexibility, motion stability and low energy consumption when being compared with the traditional robot with rigid hinge joints. And the biped robot with the bionic tension-compression joints realizes better flexibility and is of great significance to enhancing human-robot physical interaction safety and human-robot inclusion.
source_title: Biped robot with bionic tension-compression joints

abstract: PURPOSE: A frame module for changing a length and a mobile robot including the same are provided to stably correct a position according to a walking environment and move a center of gravity when the deformation into a biped walking type or a quadruped walking type is performed by controlling a length of a joint frame. CONSTITUTION: A frame module (100) for changing a length comprises a base frame (102), a motor (110), a spur gear (114), a first rack gear (116), a second rack gear (122), a main gear (128), a bar gear (130), and a third gear (140). The main gear rotates in the forward direction or in the reverse direction corresponding to a rectilinear reciprocating movement of the second rack gear. The bar gear is mounted on a central shaft of the main gear having a rotation ratio which is smaller than the main gear and rotates according to a rotation of the main gear. One end of the second rack gear is connected to a joint frame and vertically reciprocates to control a length of the joint frame by receiving a rotary force of the bar gear.
source_title: FRAME MODULE FOR CONTROLLING VARIABLE LENGTH OF FRAME AND LEGGED MOBILE ROBOT WITH IT

abstract: PURPOSE: Feet of a biped robot are provided to prevent the falling of the robot when the weight of the robot is inclined forward while walking by using a supporting member supported by the ground. CONSTITUTION: Feet(10) of a biped robot includes a robot feet body(110) and a supporting member(120). The supporting member surrounds the outside of the robot feet body. The supporting member supports the feet of the biped robot by being slid to the forward and backward directions by the location of the feet.
source_title: walking pattern of a biped robot

abstract: The invention provides a lower limb structure of a biped walking robot capable of standing vertically, which relates to the technical field of robots and comprises two leg mechanisms, namely a right leg mechanism and a left leg mechanism; the leg mechanism comprises a thigh assembly, a shank assembly, a leg motor assembly, a hip joint mechanism and a knee joint mechanism; the thigh assemblies are connected with the body through hip joint mechanisms and connected with the shank assemblies through knee joint mechanisms. The thigh body, the first thigh crank, the thigh main connecting rod and the shank body form a first parallel four-bar mechanism; the first thigh crank, the second thigh crank, the thigh auxiliary connecting rod, the third thigh crank and the shank body form a second parallel four-bar mechanism; in the movement process of the lower limb mechanism, under the condition that the first parallel four-bar mechanism moves to the singular position, the second parallel four-bar mechanism moves to drive the first parallel four-bar mechanism to pass through the singular position. The movable range of the shanks can be widened, and the stability and flexibility of robot movement are improved.
source_title: Lower limb structure of biped walking robot capable of standing vertically

abstract: The invention provides a biped robot control method and device and a biped robot, and belongs to the technical field of robot walking path determination. The method comprises the steps that a visual image, collected by a camera, of a scene where the biped robot is located currently is obtained, the visual image comprises at least one foothold, and each foothold is used for identifying a position area; affine transformation processing is conducted on the visual image according to an affine transformation matrix, the target coordinate position corresponding to a target foothold in the visual image is obtained, the affine transformation matrix is obtained by conducting calibration processing on a camera in advance, and the target foothold is the next foothold of the current foothold of the two feet of the robot; the target coordinate position is the coordinate position of the target foothold in a world coordinate system; and the two feet of the robot are controlled to walk to the target coordinate position. The target coordinate position can be obtained through the affine transformation matrix, then accurate foothold coordinate information is provided, and the walking stability of the robot is improved.
source_title: Biped robot control method and device and biped robot

abstract: The invention relates to a biped robot and a walking control method thereof. The biped robot comprises a body and double legs; a gyroscope assembly is arranged in the body of the robot and comprises at least one pair of gyroscopes, a swinging motor for controlling the gyroscopes to actively deflect, and a reverse synchronizing mechanism for controlling the pairs of gyroscopes to be the same in swinging speed and opposite in swinging direction. The gyroscope assembly is used for achieving the situation that when one of the legs is lifted, the biped robot generates the gyroscope torque with thesame magnitude and the opposite direction as the gravity torque born by the biped robot, and thus the robot keeps balance. In the whole walking process, the gravity center of the robot in the left-right direction does not need to be controlled, double feet are directly controlled to forwards step and move, the control process is simplified, the control difficulty is reduced, and the walking speedis also greatly increased.
source_title: Biped robot and walking control method thereof

abstract: PURPOSE: A walking pattern generator of a robot is provided to independently change the cycle, stride, and direction of waking of a biped robot on a slope surface inclined in longitudinal and transverse directions. CONSTITUTION: A walking pattern generator of a robot comprises a modeling part(110), a movement equation computing part(120), a CS(Command State) information converting part(130), a variable calculating part(140), and a walking pattern generating part(150). The modeling part models a biped robot on a slope surface inclined in longitudinal and transverse directions into a 3D-LIPM(3-Dimensional Linear Inverted Pendulum Model) and induces a dynamic equation for calculating a ZMP(Zero Moment Point) function and a movement equation about the center of mass of the 3D-LIPM. The movement equation computing part produces a movement equation about the center of mass of the 3D-LIPM using the dynamic equation. The CS information converting part changes a CS into a walking WS(Walking State). The variable calculating part calculates control variables of the ZMP function in order to calculate the WS. The walking pattern generating part applies the WS to the movement of the center of mass of the 3D-LIPM and creates a waling pattern corresponding to the movement of the center of mass of the 3D-LIPM.
source_title: WALKING PATTERN GENERATOR FOR ROBOT

abstract: The invention discloses a biped robot. The biped robot comprises a main body, two leg structures and a balance part, wherein the two leg structures are symmetrically installed on the two sides of the main body and can swing relative to the main body; and the balance part comprises a flywheel and a first driving piece, the first driving piece is installed on the main body, the first driving piece is connected with the flywheel and used for driving the flywheel to rotate, and the extending direction of the rotating axis of the flywheel is perpendicular to the distribution direction of the leg structures on the main body. According to the biped robot in the above embodiment, the leg structures swing relative to the main body, so the robot can avoid obstacles in an advancing process; and the torque generated by rotation of the flywheel can offset the torque applied to the main body due to lifting of the leg structures, and the robot keeps balanced in a walking process, so the walking stability of the biped robot is improved.
source_title: Biped robot

abstract: The invention discloses an integrated ankle-foot system for improving walking stability of a biped robot. The integrated ankle-foot system comprises a robot shank and ankle drive transmission system, a two-degree-of-freedom ankle joint, a bionic design foot and a foot sensing and data processing module, wherein the ankle drive transmission system is integrated in the internal space of a shank, the foot sensing and data processing module is integrated in a foot body, and the whole system is compact in design and high in integration degree. The foot part comprises a half sole passive joint and a heel buffering module, the road surface impact on the foot part can be effectively buffered, human gait-simulated walking is achieved, and the stability and the movement capacity of the robot are improved. A parallel linear driving system is integrated at the shank of the system, so that the ankle drive performance is ensured, and meanwhile, the exposure of parts of a driving transmission system is reduced. Various sensors in the system are used for collecting posture information of the road surface and the ankle-foot system, and adaptive posture adjustment of the ankle-foot system on the uneven road surface is achieved through the data processing module.
source_title: Integrated ankle-foot system for improving walking stability of biped robot

abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of robots, and discloses a multi-motion-mode robot which comprises a trunk, a crawling leg assembly and a jumping assembly. The crawling leg assemblies are installed on the left front side, the right front side, the left rear side and the right rear side of the trunk respectively, and therefore the four-foot distributed crawling robot is formed. In cooperation with a gait control strategy, the multi-motion-mode robot can generate a collaborative motion mode similar to a biological limb, and compared with a biped or hexapod robot, the multi-motion-mode robot has better ground contact stability. A jumping assembly is arranged on the belly side of the trunk, and the multi-motion-mode robot can quickly advance or cross obstacles through a jumping control strategy. In addition, when the multi-motion-mode robot turns on one side, the reset structure can be combined with part of the crawling leg assemblies to achieve self-reset. The multi-motion-mode robot is compact in structure, high in adaptability and capable of achieving high-maneuverability obstacle crossing and rollover self-resetting in complex terrains, and integrates a crawling mode and a jumping mode.
source_title: Multi-motion-mode robot

abstract: The invention discloses a 2D walking stabilizing structure of a biped robot. The 2D walking stabilizing structure includes a biped robot body. The surface of the biped robot body is provided with an obstacle-avoidance sensor. One end of the obstacle-avoidance sensor is provided with an infrared sensing transmitter. The other end of the obstacle-avoidance sensor is provided with an infrared sensingreceiver. The biped robot body comprises a head part and a walking part. The head part is provided with a rotating shaft through a connecting rod. The walking part comprises upper joints and lower joints. A bent transmission shaft is arranged between each upper joint and the corresponding lower joint. Each lower joint is connected with a foot of the robot. The surface of each foot is provided with a pressure sensor. The pressure sensors are connected with a main control box through a signal conveyor. The interior of the main control box comprises a central processing unit. One end of the central processing unit is provided with an operating chip which controls the robot to walk stably, and the other end of the central processing unit is provided with an ultrasonic sensor. The stability inthe process of walking of the robot is improved, and connection of all parts is more coordinated.
source_title: 2D walking stabilizing structure of biped robot

abstract: The invention discloses a bionic biped walking robot with heavy-load vibration buffering and stabilizing functions. The bionic biped walking robot is composed of a robot body, a coronal plane swinging mechanism and two mechanical legs. The coronal plane swinging mechanism comprises a motor, a crank and a main shaft; each mechanical leg comprises a hip joint movement mechanism, a knee joint movement mechanism, an ankle joint movement mechanism and a mechanical foot mechanism. The hip joint movement mechanism comprises a leg motor, a crank, a hip connecting rod and a thigh; the knee joint movement mechanism comprises thighs, middle legs and leg connecting rods; the ankle joint movement mechanism comprises a middle leg and a shank; the mechanical foot mechanism comprises two foot motors and two toes, and each toe is composed of a damping spring, an upper foot plate and a foot bottom plate. The biped robot capable of achieving two-dimensional movement, heavy load and vibration reduction is designed by simulating the biological anatomical structure and hind limb movement characteristics of an ostrich. Movement of the mechanical leg on the sagittal plane and the coronal plane is achieved through the coronal plane swing mechanism and the hip joint movement mechanism, and the heavy load vibration reduction target of the mechanical leg is achieved through the bearing joints and the toe mechanism.
source_title: Bionic biped walking robot with heavy-load vibration buffering and stabilizing functions

abstract: The invention discloses a wall-climbing type robot with an effect of two-feet coordinated actuation. The wall-climbing robot comprises front feet, rear feet, a PLC, a telescopic moving rod and a spring, wherein the bottoms of the front feet and rear feet are respectively connected with two negative-pressure parts; the telescopic moving rod is connected between the front feet and the rear feet, and comprises a fixed rod, a sleeve and a fixed rod which are sequentially fixed between the front feet and the rear feet, as well as springs sleeving outside the fixed rod, the sleeve and the fixed rod; one ends, close to the front feet or rear feet, of the springs are connected through vertical servo motors, so that the robot is driven to move back and forth; tee connectors are connected with outer parts of a sleeve in left and right directions, and are sequentially connected with transverse telescopic sleeves, transverse moving rods and transverse servo motors; the transverse servo motors are used for driving the transverse moving rods to move transversely, so that front feet and rear feet are driven to move transversely. The wall-climbing robot has the characteristics of strong wall face structure shape adaptability, high stability, wall face material limit independence, flexible movement, strong usability, safety, reliability and the like.
source_title: Wall-climbing type robot with effect of two-feet coordinated actuation

abstract: The invention provides a multi-modal motion bionic inchworm crawling and climbing soft robot, which comprises feet and three deformable bodies sequentially connected between the two feet, and each deformable body is provided with an extensible face and a non-extensible face. The extensible faces are located on the opposite sides of the non-extensible faces so that the deformable bodies can deform between a linear structure and a C-shaped structure, and when the three deformable bodies are all in a linear structure, the direction of the non-extensible face of the middle deformable body is the same as the direction of the ground grabbing face of the foot, and the direction of the non-extensible face of the middle deformable body is opposite to the direction of the non-extensible faces of the deformable bodies located on the two sides, so that the deformable bodies can be matched with the feet in a flexible deformation mode to complete the horizontal crawling action and/or the climbing action. The multi-modal motion bionic inchworm crawling and climbing soft robot is simple in structure, light in mass and good in compliance, has the ability of multi-modal motion, adapts to motion in different environments and active conversion among the motions, and expands the motion adaptability of the soft robot in a complex environment.
source_title: Multi-modal motion bionic inchworm crawling and climbing soft robot

abstract: A locomotion control system for a biped walking robot having a body and two legs each connected to the body through a hip joint and each having ankle joint adjacent to its foot portion. A walking patter is preestablished in advance in terms of a trajectory of IMP (Zero Moment Point) at which horizontal moment acting on the robot generated by the ground reaction force is zero, a trajectory of the body's attitude or the like. During walking, actual ground reaction force is detected to determine an actual ZMP position and detected position is compared with a target IMP position obtained from the IMP trajectory. When there is an error between the positions, the robot legs are driven in such a manner that the error decreases. More specifically, if the actual IMP position is shifted forward the target ZMP position, the moment produced therefrom causes the robot to tilt backward. Therefore, it is controlled such that the forward foot is lifted vertically, while the rearward foot is lowered vertically, thus producing a moment in the opposite direction to restore the stable attitude. The robot can therefore be simulated as an inverted pendulum so that constantly maintains a prescribed restoration force and control characteristics becomes liner. Various embodiments are proposed for the same purpose. Alternatively, output rate of time series data is changed in response to the robot's unstable attitude.
source_title: Locomotion control system for legged mobile robot

abstract: The invention discloses a spherical joint magnetic levitation permanent magnet motor bipedal walking robot. The spherical joint magnetic levitation permanent magnet motor bipedal walking robot is usedfor assisting people in walking to reduce people's energy consumption in the long-time walking process and can also be used for a lower limb rehabilitation training. The spherical joint magnetic levitation permanent magnet motor bipedal walking robot comprises a thigh drive spherical mechanism, a calf drive spherical mechanism, a leg drive spherical mechanism, a hip structure, a power source anda drive controller. According to the spherical joint magnetic levitation permanent magnet motor bipedal walking robot, a magnetoelectric angular displacement sensor is used for detecting space swinging angles among the thigh, the calf and the foot. An electromagnet is used for pushing a permanent magnet motor rotor to make the spherical rotor suspend. A spherical stator is used for driving a permanent magnet rotor to rotate. The lengths of the thigh and the calf can be adjusted by the adjustment of set bolts on the thigh and the calf, and therefore the spherical joint magnetic levitation permanent magnet motor bipedal walking robot is suitable for different groups. The spherical joint magnetic levitation permanent magnet motor bipedal walking robot can be used for the lower limb rehabilitation training and reducing people's energy consumption in walking.
source_title: Spherical joint magnetic levitation permanent magnet motor bipedal walking robot

abstract: The invention discloses a multi-foot robot based on flexible bending structures, which comprises at least two feet, and each foot comprises a flexible bending structure; the flexible bending structure comprises a soft body formed by sequentially connecting a plurality of hard outer frames and a plurality of soft silica gel base bodies in a staggered mode. The connecting component is used for connecting each foot; a steering engine is arranged at the bottom of each foot, and an adhesive tape is adhered to the upper part of the steering wheel of each steering engine in the circumferential direction; the robot further comprises a control module, and the control module controls the operation states of a first gear motor and a second gear motor of the flexible bending structure to achieve bending of the flexible bending module according to needs. The control module controls the steering wheel to rotate so that the glue sticker can make contact with the ground according to needs. When the robot crawl, the front feet and the rear feet alternately land or lift up. The marching mode of bionic marine organisms is adopted, and the marching stability of the multi-legged robot on different road conditions is improved. And meanwhile, the multi-legged robot has a large load.
source_title: Multi-legged robot based on flexible bending structure
